qe: What were the ancient people living on the banks of the Narmada river primarily?
qh: नर्मदा नदी के तट पर रहने वाले प्राचीन लोग मुख्य रूप से क्या थे?
e: Narmada nadi ke kinare rehne wale log skilled gatherers the, jinko aas-paas ke jungle ke ped-paudhon aur unke products ki bohot acchi jaankari thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki narmada nadi ke tat par rahane vale prachin log mukhy rup se kya the? Isi aadhar par Skilled Gatherers chuna jaata hai. Artisans, Merchants, Farmers is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Skilled Gatherers hi hai. Exam point: Skilled Gatherers - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which hills of the North-West did people start growing crops like wheat and barley about 8000 years ago?
qh: उत्तर-पश्चिम की किन पहाड़ियों में लगभग 8000 साल पहले लोगों ने गेहूँ और जौ जैसी फसलें उगाना शुरू किया था?
e: Sulaiman aur Kirthar hills ke area me lagbhag 8000 saal pehle gehun aur jau ugane ke sabse shuruati saboot milte hain. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki uttar-pashchim ki kin pahadaiyon mein lagabhag 8000 sal pahale logon ne gehun aur jau jaisi phasalein ugana shuru kiya tha? Isi tathya par Sulaiman & Kirthar tika hua hai. Galti Himalayas, Vindhyas, Garo Hills chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Sulaiman & Kirthar hi hai. Exam point: Sulaiman & Kirthar - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which crop was first cultivated to the north of the Vindhya hills?
qh: विंध्य पहाड़ियों के उत्तर में सबसे पहले किस फसल की खेती की गई थी?
e: Vindhya hills ke north wale areas (jaise Koldihwa) me sabse pehle chawal (rice) ugane ke praman mile hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki vindhy pahadaiyon ke uttar mein sabase pahale kis phasal ki kheti ki gai thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Rice sahi nikalta hai. Galti Barley, Cotton, Wheat chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Rice hai. Exam point: Rice - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: On which characters did Mahasweta Devi focus in her work 'Kunti O Nishadi'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध बंगाली लेखिका महाश्वेता देवी ने 'कुंती ओ निषादी' में किन पात्रों पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया?
e: Unhone Mahabharata ki story ko marginalized Nishad community ke perspective se reframe kiya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki prasiddh bangali lekhika mahashveta devi ne 'kunti o nishadi' mein kin patron par dhyan keindrit kiya? Isi tathya par Nishads and marginalized groups tika hua hai. Foreign traders, Only Pandavas, Only Kauravas in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Nishads and marginalized groups hai. Exam point: Nishads and marginalized groups - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who were referred to as 'Heterodox Sects' around 600 BCE?
qh: 600 BCE के दौरान 'हेटेरोडॉक्स सेक्ट्स' (Heterodox Sects) किन्हें कहा गया?
e: Heterodox sects un movements ko kaha gaya jinhone Brahmanical rituals aur rigid orthodox concepts ka virodh kiya, jaise Buddhism aur Jainism. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 600 BCE ke dauran 'heterodoks sekts' (Heterodox Sects) kinhein kaha gaya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Opponents of orthodox traditions hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Followers of Brahmanical traditions, Composers of Vedas, Group of kings only alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Opponents of orthodox traditions hi hai. Exam point: Opponents of orthodox traditions - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Mandals of the Rigveda are considered the oldest and known as 'Family Books'?
qh: ऋग्वेद के कौन से मंडल सबसे पुराने माने जाते हैं और उन्हें 'फैमिली बुक्स' कहा जाता है?
e: Rigveda ke Mandals 2 se 7 sabse purane hain aur inko rishi parivaron dwara compose kiya gaya tha, isliye inhe Family Books kehte hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki rigved ke kaun se mandal sabase purane mane jate hain aur unhein 'phaimili buks' kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 2 to 7 hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Only 10th, 1 to 5, 8 to 10 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav 2 to 7 hi thehrta hai. Exam point: 2 to 7 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which Veda primarily deals with melodies, music, and chanting of hymns?
qh: किस वेद में मुख्य रूप से संगीत और मंत्रों के गायन की चर्चा की गई है?
e: Samaveda ko Indian classical music ki root maana jata hai, jisme Rigvedic hymns ko gaane ke dhang me compose kiya gaya hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kis ved mein mukhy rup se sangit aur mantron ke gayan ki charcha ki gai hai? Isliye antim jawab Samaveda ke roop mein milta hai. Yajurveda, Atharvaveda, Rigveda in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Samaveda hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Samaveda - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the literal meaning of the word 'Upanishad'?
qh: उपनिषद (Upanishad) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
e: Upanishad ka literal meaning hota hai guru ke paas baithkar secret ya spiritual gyan prapt karna. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki upanishad (Upanishad) shabd ka shabdik arth kya hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par To approach and sit near hi sahi baithta hai. To perform sacrifice, White garment, To conquer war ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar To approach and sit near baithta hai. Exam point: To approach and sit near - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the term 'Tirthankara' mean in Jain tradition?
qh: जैन धर्म में 'तीर्थंकर' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: A spiritual teacher showing path to salvation
e: Tirthankara ka matlab hota hai sansar-sagar ko paar karake moksha ka rasta dikhane wale spiritual guide. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki jain dharm mein 'tirthankar' shabd ka kya arth hai? Isi karan se A spiritual teacher showing path to salvation sahi uttar hai. A great warrior, Brahmin priest, One wearing white robes alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar A spiritual teacher showing path to salvation hi hai. Exam point: A spiritual teacher showing path to salvation - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the 24th and last Tirthankara of Jainism?
qh: जैन धर्म के 24वें और अंतिम तीर्थंकर कौन थे?
e: Vardhamana Mahavira Jain dharam ke 24ve aur antim Tirthankara the jinhone isko organize kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki jain dharm ke 24vein aur antim tirthankar kaun the? Isi aadhar par Vardhamana Mahavira chuna jaata hai. Gautama Buddha, Parshvanatha, Rishabhadeva mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Vardhamana Mahavira hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Vardhamana Mahavira - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which vow was added by Lord Mahavira to the existing four vows in Jainism?
qh: भगवान महावीर ने जैन धर्म के पाँच व्रतों में कौन सा नया व्रत जोड़ा था?
e: Parshvanatha ke chaar vrato me Mahavira ne paanchva vrat 'Brahmacharya' (celibacy) add kiya tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bhagavan mahavir ne jain dharm ke panch vraton mein kaun sa naya vrat joda tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Brahmacharya sahi hai. Asteya, Ahimsa, Aparigraha mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Brahmacharya hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Brahmacharya - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which sect of Jainism is known for wearing white clothes?
qh: जैन धर्म का कौन सा संप्रदाय सफेद वस्त्र धारण करता है?
e: Shvetambara sect ke followers white clothes pehante hain jabki Digambara tradition me sky-clad (nude) raha jata hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki jain dharm ka kaun sa sanpraday saphed vastr dharan karata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Shvetambara hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - Digambara, Ajivika, Mahayana - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Shvetambara hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Shvetambara - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where was Siddhartha (Gautama Buddha) born in 563 BCE?
qh: गौतम बुद्ध का जन्म 563 BCE में कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Gautama Buddha ka birth Nepal ke paas Lumbini namak sthan par hua tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki gautam buddh ka janm 563 BCE mein kahan hua tha? Isi baat se Lumbini sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Kushinagar, Bodh Gaya, Sarnath chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Lumbini hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Lumbini - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Buddhist Pitaka contains the collection of Buddha's sermons and dialogues?
qh: बुद्ध के उपदेशों और उनके शिष्यों के बीच हुई बातचीत का संग्रह किस पिटक में है?
e: Sutta Pitaka me Buddha ke mukhya updesh, dialogues aur teachings ka sankalan hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki buddh ke upadeshon aur unake shishyon ke bich hui batachit ka sangrah kis pitak mein hai? Isi karan se Sutta Pitaka sahi uttar hai. Galti Vinaya Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka, Ashokavadana chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Sutta Pitaka hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sutta Pitaka - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which Buddhist text are the monastic rules of the Sangha compiled?
qh: बुद्ध धर्म के नियमों (संघ के नियमों) का संकलन किस पुस्तक में मिलता है?
e: Vinaya Pitaka me monastics aur Sangha ke anushasan ke rules diye gaye hain. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki buddh dharm ke niyamon (sangh ke niyamon) ka sankalan kis pustak mein milata hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Vinaya Pitaka hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Jataka Tales, Sutta Pitaka, Abhidhamma Pitaka anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Vinaya Pitaka hi hai. Exam point: Vinaya Pitaka - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Where did Gautama Buddha deliver his first sermon (Dharmachakrapravartana)?
qh: बुद्ध ने अपना पहला उपदेश (Dharmachakrapravartana) कहाँ दिया था?
e: Enlightenment pane ke baad Buddha ne apna first sermon Varanasi ke paas Sarnath me diya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki buddh ne apana pahala upadesh (Dharmachakrapravartana) kahan diya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Sarnath hi sahi baithta hai. Bodh Gaya, Lumbini, Kushinagar mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Sarnath hai. Exam point: Sarnath - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What is the primary objective of the 'Eightfold Path' (Ashtangika Marga) in Buddhism?
qh: बुद्ध धर्म के 'अष्टांगिक मार्ग' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Ashtangika Marga ka maksad dukhon ka ant karke Nirvana prapt karna hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki buddh dharm ke 'ashtangik marg' ka mukhy uddeshy kya hai? Isi aadhar par Ending suffering and achieving Nirvana chuna jaata hai. Animal sacrifice, Winning wars, Reaching heaven is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Ending suffering and achieving Nirvana hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Ending suffering and achieving Nirvana - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who was the first woman admitted into the Buddhist Sangha as a nun?
qh: बुद्ध संघ में शामिल होने वाली पहली महिला कौन थी?
e: Buddha ki foster mother Mahaprajapati Gotami Sangha me aane wali pehli bhikshuni thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki buddh sangh mein shamil hone vali pahali mahila kaun thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Mahaprajapati Gotami sahi nikalta hai. Galti Yashodhara, Amrapali, Maya Devi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Mahaprajapati Gotami hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Mahaprajapati Gotami - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which Indian state is the famous Sanchi Stupa situated?
qh: सांची का स्तूप भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Sanchi Stupa Madhya Pradesh ke Raisen district me Bhopal ke paas situated hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sanchi ka stup bharat ke kis rajy mein sthit hai? stupa Buddha ke avsheshon par bana dher jaisa smarak hota tha. Yahi wajah hai ki Madhya Pradesh sahi hai. Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Madhya Pradesh baithta hai. Exam point: Madhya Pradesh - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which Begums of Bhopal provided financial aid and resources to preserve the Sanchi Stupa?
qh: भोपाल की किन बेगमों ने सांची के स्तूप को संरक्षित करने में योगदान दिया?
o: Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum
e: Shahjehan Begum aur Sultan Jehan Begum ne Sanchi ke preservation aur museum ke liye funding di thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki bhopal ki kin begamon ne sanchi ke stup ko sanrakshit karane mein yogadan diya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum sahi nikalta hai. Razia Sultan, Nur Jahan and Mumtaz, Jahanara alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum hai. Exam point: Shahjehan Begum and Sultan Jehan Begum - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the balcony-like structure 'Harmika' represent atop a Buddhist Stupa?
qh: स्तूप में बालकनी जैसी संरचना 'हर्मिका' क्या दर्शाती है?
e: Ande ke upar sthit Harmika ek balcony-like structure hoti hai jise devtaon ka niwas maana jata hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki stup mein balakani jaisi sanrachana 'harmika' kya darshati hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Abode of the Gods sahi nikalta hai. King's throne, Main entrance, Royal treasury ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Abode of the Gods hi hai. Exam point: Abode of the Gods - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What are the stories of Buddha's previous births known as?
qh: बुद्ध के पिछले जन्मों की कहानियों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Jataka tales me Buddha ke pichhle janmo ki kahaniya di gayi hain jo moral sikh deti hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki buddh ke pichhale janmon ki kahaniyon ko kya kaha jata hai? tripitaka Buddhist granthon ka samooh hai jismein vinaya, sutta tatha abhidhamma aate hain. Isliye antim jawab Jataka Tales ke roop mein milta hai. Puranas, Upanishads, Tripitaka is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Jataka Tales hai. Exam point: Jataka Tales - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Buddhist sect started worshipping images of Buddha and Bodhisattvas?
qh: कौन सा बौद्ध संप्रदाय बुद्ध को भगवान मानकर उनकी मूर्ति पूजा करता है?
e: Mahayana Buddhism me Buddha ko divine maankar unki aur Bodhisattvas ki murti puja shuru hui. Prashn yah batata hai ki kaun sa bauddh sanpraday buddh ko bhagavan manakar unaki murti puja karata hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Mahayana hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Ajivika, Hinayana, Theravada alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Mahayana hi milti hai. Exam point: Mahayana - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the Amravati Stupa get destroyed while the Sanchi Stupa survived intact?
qh: अमरावती का स्तूप क्यों नष्ट हो गया, जबकि सांची का स्तूप बच गया?
o: Lack of timely in-situ protection and looting of sculptures
e: Amravati ko in-situ preserve nahi kiya gaya aur uske pathar-sculptures log nikal kar le gaye, jabki Sanchi ko time par bacha liya gaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki amaravati ka stup kyon nasht ho gaya, jabaki sanchi ka stup bach gaya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Lack of timely in-situ protection and looting of sculptures hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Destruction in a great war, Due to being much older, Devastating earthquake anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Lack of timely in-situ protection and looting of sculptures hi milti hai. Exam point: Lack of timely in-situ protection and looting of sculptures - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which site of the Indus Valley Civilization literally translates to the 'Mound of the Dead'?
qh: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का कौन सा स्थल 'मृतकों का टीला' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
e: Sindhi bhasha me Mohenjo-daro ka exact meaning 'Mound of the Dead' hota hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki sindhu ghati sabhyata ka kaun sa sthal 'mritakon ka tila' ke rup mein jana jata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Mohenjo-daro nikalta hai. Harappa, Lothal, Kalibangan in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Mohenjo-daro hi milti hai. Exam point: Mohenjo-daro - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which Mandal of the Rigveda is the famous Gayatri Mantra composed?
qh: प्रसिद्ध गायत्री मंत्र ऋग्वेद के किस मंडल में संकलित है?
e: Gayatri Mantra Rigveda ke 3rd Mandal me hai jise Maharshi Vishvamitra ne Savitr devta ko samarpit kiya tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki prasiddh gayatri mantr rigved ke kis mandal mein sankalit hai? In tathyon ke chalte 3rd hi sahi hai. 10th, 1st, 9th anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 3rd hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 3rd - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: For how many days did the Kurukshetra war last according to the Mahabharata?
qh: महाभारत का युद्ध कुरुक्षेत्र में कितने दिनों तक चला था?
e: Kauravon aur Pandavon ke beech Kurukshetra ka yuddh 18 dino tak chala tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mahabharat ka yuddh kurukshetr mein kitane dinon tak chala tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 18 days sahi hai. 10 days, 20 days, 15 days in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab 18 days hai. Exam point: 18 days - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which language were the core canonical Buddhist texts 'Tripitaka' composed?
qh: प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध ग्रंथ 'त्रिपिटक' किस भाषा में लिखे गए हैं?
e: Shuruati Buddhist Tripitakas ko aam logo ki boli Pali bhasha me compose kiya gaya tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki prasiddh bauddh granth 'tripitak' kis bhasha mein likhe gae hain? tripitaka Buddhist granthon ka samooh hai jismein vinaya, sutta tatha abhidhamma aate hain. Isliye antim jawab Pali ke roop mein milta hai. Sanskrit, Ardhamagadhi, Prakrit ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Pali hai. Exam point: Pali - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which artifact is considered the most distinctive archaeological hallmark of the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की सबसे विशिष्ट पुरावस्तु किसे माना जाता है?
e: Steatite se bani Harappan seals sabse distinctive artifact hain jin par janwaron ke chitra aur undeciphered script milti hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki hadappa sabhyata ki sabase vishisht puravastu kise mana jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Harappan Seal sahi nikalta hai. Gold ornaments, Iron tools, Earthen pots in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Harappan Seal hi hai. Exam point: Harappan Seal - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which metal was completely unknown to the people of the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के लोग किस धातु का उपयोग नहीं जानते थे?
e: Harappan civilization Bronze Age ki thi; unhe Iron (lohe) ki bilkul jaankari nahi thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki hadappa sabhyata ke log kis dhatu ka upayog nahin janate the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Iron hi sahi baithta hai. Copper, Gold, Bronze mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Iron hi hai. Exam point: Iron - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: From which Indus Valley site has the earliest evidence of a ploughed field been discovered?
qh: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता में जूते हुए खेत के साक्ष्य कहाँ से मिले हैं?
e: Rajasthan ke Kalibangan se early Harappan level par ploughed field ke nishan mile hain. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki sindhu ghati sabhyata mein jute hue khet ke sakshy kahan se mile hain? Isi tathya par Kalibangan tika hua hai. Vikalp Lothal, Banawali, Harappa bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Kalibangan hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Kalibangan - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Harappan settlements were primarily divided into which two morphological sections?
qh: हड़प्पाई शहरों को मुख्य रूप से किन दो हिस्सों में विभाजित किया गया था?
e: Zyadatar Harappan shehar do parts me bate the: uncha chhota Citadel (Durg) aur bada Lower Town (Neechla shahar). Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki hadappai shaharon ko mukhy rup se kin do hisson mein vibhajit kiya gaya tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. In tathyon ke chalte Citadel and Lower Town hi sahi hai. Upper and Middle town, Eastern and Western port, Palace and Bazaar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Citadel and Lower Town hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Citadel and Lower Town - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which of the following statements is true regarding the Harappan script?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की लिपि के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: It was written from left to right only
It remains undeciphered to this day
e: Harappan script ek pictographic script thi jisme 375-400 signs hain aur isko aaj tak padha nahi ja saka hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki hadappa sabhyata ki lipi ke bare mein kya sahi hai? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. In tathyon ke chalte It remains undeciphered to this day hi sahi hai. It was written from left to right only, It contained only 26 signs, It was alphabetic is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan It remains undeciphered to this day hi milti hai. Exam point: It remains undeciphered to this day - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which red-coloured stone was prominently used by Harappans for crafting beads?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में मनके बनाने के लिए किस लाल रंग के पत्थर का उपयोग किया जाता था?
e: Carnelian ek beautiful laal rang ka stone tha jiska use beading craft me broad level par hota tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata mein manake banane ke lie kis lal rang ke patthar ka upayog kiya jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Carnelian sahi hai. Galti Steatite, Jasper, Quartz chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Carnelian hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Carnelian - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What specific stone was standardized to manufacture cubical weights in the Harappan civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के बाट मुख्य रूप से किस पत्थर से बनाए जाते थे?
e: Chert naam ke stone se Harappans cubical standardized weights banate the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki hadappa sabhyata ke bat mukhy rup se kis patthar se banae jate the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Chert hi sahi baithta hai. Marble, Granite, Sandstone anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Chert hi hai. Exam point: Chert - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: At which Harappan site were traces of ancient irrigation canals found?
qh: किस हड़प्पाई स्थल से नहरों के अवशेष मिले हैं?
e: Afghanistan ke Shortughai namak Harappan site se canals ke remnants paye gaye hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki kis hadappai sthal se naharon ke avashesh mile hain? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isi aadhar par Shortughai chuna jaata hai. Galti Kalibangan, Lothal, Dholavira chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Shortughai hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Shortughai - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Where was the 'Great Bath' situated within Mohenjo-daro?
qh: मोहनजोदड़ो में 'विशाल स्नानागार' कहाँ स्थित था?
e: Great Bath Mohenjo-daro ke unche Citadel area par banaya gaya tha jo ritualistic bathing ke liye tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mohanajodadao mein 'vishal snanagar' kahan sthit tha? Isi aadhar par On the Citadel chuna jaata hai. Vikalp In the outer market, In the Lower Town, Outside the city walls bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar On the Citadel hai. Exam point: On the Citadel - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the standardized dimensional ratio of length, breadth, and thickness of Harappan bricks?
qh: हड़प्पाई ईंटों का लंबाई, चौड़ाई और ऊंचाई का मानक अनुपात क्या था?
e: Harappan bricks ka standard ratio 4:2:1 tha (length 4x, breadth 2x, aur height 1x thi). Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki hadappai inton ka lanbai, chaudai aur unchai ka manak anupat kya tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. In tathyon ke chalte 4:2:1 hi sahi hai. 2:2:1, 1:2:3, 4:4:2 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar 4:2:1 baithta hai. Exam point: 4:2:1 - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Specialized bead-making workshops and factories were discovered at which two Harappan sites?
qh: मनके बनाने के कारखाने किन दो प्रमुख हड़प्पाई स्थलों पर मिले हैं?
e: Chanhudaro aur Lothal specialized centers the jahan se bead-making ke furnaces aur tools mile hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki manake banane ke karakhane kin do pramukh hadappai sthalon par mile hain? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Lothal and Chanhudaro nikalta hai. Nageshwar and Balakot, Harappa and Mohenjo-daro, Kalibangan and Banawali alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Lothal and Chanhudaro hi hai. Exam point: Lothal and Chanhudaro - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the primary design feature of the Harappan civic drainage system?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की जल निकास प्रणाली की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: Covered drains laid out in a grid pattern
Drains restricted only to palatial complexes
e: Drains aur galiyan grid pattern par bani thi, jisme gharo ki naliyan road ki covered naliyo se judti thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata ki jal nikas pranali ki mukhy visheshata kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Covered drains laid out in a grid pattern hi sahi baithta hai. Drains restricted only to palatial complexes, Open untreated channels, Total absence of underground sewers is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Covered drains laid out in a grid... hi hai. Exam point: Covered drains laid out in a grid pattern - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which coastal settlements served as specialized manufacturing centers for shell objects?
qh: शंख से बनी वस्तुओं के उत्पादन के प्रमुख केंद्र कौन से थे?
e: Nageshwar aur Balakot samundar ke kinare the, isliye wahan shankh (shell) se bangles aur inlays banaye jaate the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki shankh se bani vastuon ke utpadan ke pramukh keindr kaun se the? Isi baat se Nageshwar and Balakot sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Kot Diji and Amri, Lothal and Chanhudaro, Harappa and Rakhigarhi chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Nageshwar and Balakot hi milti hai. Exam point: Nageshwar and Balakot - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In Mesopotamian cuneiform inscriptions, which region is referred to as 'Meluhha'?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लेखों में 'मेलुहा' शब्द का प्रयोग संभवतः किस क्षेत्र के लिए किया गया है?
e: Mesopotamian records me Indus Valley region ko 'Meluhha' (land of seafarers) kaha gaya hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya ke lekhon mein 'meluha' shabd ka prayog sanbhavatah kis kshetr ke lie kiya gaya hai? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Harappan region sahi hai. Galti Bahrain, Oman, Egypt chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Harappan region hi milti hai. Exam point: Harappan region - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who officially announced the discovery of the Indus Valley Civilization to the world in 1924?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की खोज की घोषणा 1924 में किसने की थी?
e: ASI ke Director-General Sir John Marshall ne 1924 me world ke aage Indus Valley Civilization ki discovery declare ki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata ki khoj ki ghoshana 1924 mein kisane ki thi? Isi aadhar par John Marshall chuna jaata hai. R.E.M. Wheeler, Daya Ram Sahni, Alexander Cunningham anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan John Marshall hi milti hai. Exam point: John Marshall - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How did archaeologists interpret heavily adorned female terracotta figurines from Harappan sites?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में भारी आभूषणों वाली नारी मूर्तियों को क्या संज्ञा दी गई है?
e: Archaeologists ne aisi terracotta female figures ko fertility aur puja se associate karte hue Mother Goddess maana. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki hadappa sabhyata mein bhari abhushanon vali nari murtiyon ko kya sanjna di gai hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Mother Goddesses hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Decorative clay toys, Foreign tribute idols, Portraits of queens chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Mother Goddesses sahi hai. Exam point: Mother Goddesses - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who proposed the theory that Aryan invasion caused the catastrophic collapse of Harappan cities?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के अंत के लिए 'आर्य आक्रमण' का सिद्धांत किसने दिया था?
e: Mortimer Wheeler ne Rigveda ke 'Purandara' (fort-destroyer) reference ke base par Aryan invasion theory suggest ki thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki hadappa sabhyata ke ant ke lie 'ary akraman' ka siddhant kisane diya tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isi karan se R.E.M. Wheeler sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Alexander Cunningham, G.F. Dales, John Marshall bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan R.E.M. Wheeler hi milti hai. Exam point: R.E.M. Wheeler - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who is venerated as the 'Father of Indian Archaeology'?
qh: भारतीय पुरातत्व का जनक (Father of Indian Archaeology) किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Alexander Cunningham ASI ke first Director-General the aur unhe Father of Indian Archaeology kaha jata hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki bharatiy puratatv ka janak (Father of Indian Archaeology) kise kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Alexander Cunningham hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - Daya Ram Sahni, John Marshall, Rakhal Das Banerji - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Alexander Cunningham hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Alexander Cunningham - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why were small pots made of 'Faience' regarded as precious and luxurious in Harappan culture?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता में 'फ़यान्स' से बने पात्रों को कीमती क्यों माना जाता था?
o: Because they were imported from Rome
Because of their colossal storage size
Because they were difficult and complex to manufacture
Because they were made of real gold
e: Faience ko sand, gum aur color mix karke fire karke banaya jata tha, jo ek complex aur mehangi technique thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki hadappa sabhyata mein 'phayans' se bane patron ko kimati kyon mana jata tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isi tathya par Because they were difficult and complex to... tika hua hai. Because they were imported from Rome, Because of their colossal storage size, Because they were made of real gold ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Because they were difficult and complex to... hi hai. Exam point: Because they were difficult and complex to... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Approximately how many wells were excavated across the urban settlements of Mohenjo-daro?
qh: मोहनजोदड़ो में लगभग कितने कुएं (Wells) मिले हैं?
e: Mohenjo-daro me street aur houses ke andar total milakar lagbhag 700 wells ke traces mile hain. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mohanajodadao mein lagabhag kitane kuen (Wells) mile hain? Isi tathya par 700 tika hua hai. Galti 500, 1000, 100 chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 700 hi hai. Exam point: 700 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which animal motif occurs most predominantly on the seals of the Indus Valley Civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता की मुहरों पर किस जानवर का चित्र सबसे अधिक मिलता है?
e: Harappan seals par mythical one-horned animal (Unicorn) ka depiction sabse frequent milta hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata ki muharon par kis janavar ka chitr sabase adhik milata hai? Isi tathya par Unicorn tika hua hai. Galti Lion, Cow, Camel chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Unicorn sahi hai. Exam point: Unicorn - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the primary objective of studying 'Stratigraphy' in archaeological excavations?
qh: पुरातत्व में 'स्तरविन्यास' (Stratigraphy) का क्या उपयोग है?
o: Understanding the relative chronological sequence of cultural layers
e: Mound excavation me mitti ki parato (strata) ka study karne se artifacts ki relative chronology aur age samajh aati hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki puratatv mein 'staravinyas' (Stratigraphy) ka kya upayog hai? Isliye antim jawab Understanding the relative chronological sequence of cultural... ke roop mein milta hai. Crushing building boulders, Laying out sewage pipes, Testing chemical texture of mud alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Understanding the relative chronological sequence of cultural layers hi hai. Exam point: Understanding the relative chronological sequence of cultural... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: At which Harappan site was an artificial brick-built tidal dockyard unearthed?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता का 'गोदीबाड़ा' (Dockyard) कहाँ मिला है?
e: Gujarat ke Lothal me Sabarmati ki tributary Bhogavo nadi ke paas tidal dockyard mila hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata ka 'godibada' (Dockyard) kahan mila hai? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. In tathyon ke chalte Lothal hi sahi hai. Galti Nageshwar, Dholavira, Kalibangan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Lothal baithta hai. Exam point: Lothal - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which direction was the Harappan script commonly inscribed?
qh: हड़प्पाई लिपि को किस दिशा में लिखा जाता था?
e: Right side wide spacing aur left side cramped signs se pata chalta hai ki Harappan script right-to-left likhi jaati thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki hadappai lipi ko kis disha mein likha jata tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Right to left sahi hai. Vikalp Top to bottom, Left to right, Bottom to top bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Right to left hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Right to left - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Around which timeframe did the widespread decline and abandonment of Mature Harappan sites begin?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता का विनाश लगभग किस वर्ष के बाद शुरू हुआ?
e: Lagbhag 1900 BCE ke aaspas distinctive urban traits (seals, standardized weights) khatam hone lage the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki hadappa sabhyata ka vinash lagabhag kis varsh ke bad shuru hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 1900 BCE hi sahi baithta hai. 1300 BCE, 1500 BCE, 2600 BCE alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 1900 BCE hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 1900 BCE - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In which century did the Aztecs migrate and establish their civilization in Central Mexico?
qh: मध्य मेक्सिको की प्रसिद्ध 'एज़्टेक' (Aztec) सभ्यता की स्थापना लगभग किस शताब्दी में हुई थी?
e: Aztecs 12th century me north se central Mexican valley me aaye aur aage chalkar empire build kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki madhy meksiko ki prasiddh 'ejatek' (Aztec) sabhyata ki sthapana lagabhag kis shatabdi mein hui thi? In tathyon ke chalte 12th century hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - 14th century, 16th century, 10th century - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 12th century hi hai. Exam point: 12th century - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The name of the country 'Mexico' was derived from which Aztec patron deity?
qh: मेक्सिको (Mexico) देश का नाम एज़्टेक के किस देवता के नाम पर पड़ा है?
e: Aztecs ke war god 'Mextli' ke naam se modern Mexico word derive hua hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki meksiko (Mexico) desh ka nam ejatek ke kis devata ke nam par pada hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Mextli hi sahi baithta hai. Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc, Huitzilopochtli is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Mextli hai. Exam point: Mextli - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the capital of the Aztec Empire, built on reclaimed land in Lake Texcoco?
qh: एज़्टेक सभ्यता की राजधानी का नाम क्या था, जिसे झील को सुखाकर बनाया गया था?
e: Tenochtitlan Aztec empire ki capital thi jise Lake Texcoco ke beech me channels aur causeways ke sath banaya gaya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki ejatek sabhyata ki rajadhani ka nam kya tha, jise jhil ko sukhakar banaya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab Tenochtitlan ke roop mein milta hai. Cuzco, Teotihuacan, Machu Picchu anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Tenochtitlan hai. Exam point: Tenochtitlan - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the agricultural 'Chinampas' constructed by the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक लोगों द्वारा बनाई गई 'चिनाम्पा' (Chinampas) क्या थीं?
e: Chinampas lake surface par mud aur reeds se banaye gaye artificial floating islands the jin par intensive farming hoti thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki ejatek logon dvara banai gai 'chinampa' (Chinampas) kya thin? Yahi wajah hai ki Artificial floating agricultural islands sahi hai. Stone war axes, Gold tribute tokens, War canoes mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Artificial floating agricultural islands hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Artificial floating agricultural islands - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which celestial entity held the supreme religious significance in Aztec society?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण देवता कौन थे?
e: Aztecs Sun God ko universe ka center maante the aur unko energy dene ke liye human sacrifices karte the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki ejatek samaj mein sabase mahatvapurn devata kaun the? Isi karan se Sun God sahi uttar hai. Rain God, Fire God, Moon God in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Sun God hai. Exam point: Sun God - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What was the function of 'Calmecac' schools in Aztec society?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में बच्चों के लिए 'कालमेकाक' (Calmecac) नामक संस्थान किस उद्देश्य के लिए थे?
o: Religious and military training for noble youths
e: Calmecac elite noble class ke ladko ke schools the jahan unhe religion, law aur military leadership sikhayi jaati thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ejatek samaj mein bachchon ke lie 'kalamekak' (Calmecac) namak sansthan kis uddeshy ke lie the? Yahi wajah hai ki Religious and military training for noble youths sahi hai. Vocational pottery only, Trade guild accounting, Culinary arts is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Religious and military training for noble youths hai. Exam point: Religious and military training for noble youths - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who were the 'Pochteca' in the socio-economic structure of the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'पोचतेका' (Pochteca) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
e: Pochteca specialized elite merchants the jo long-distance foreign trade ke sath-sath state ke liye spies ka kaam karte the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki ejatek samaj mein 'pochateka' (Pochteca) kinhein kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Privileged merchant-traders and intelligence agents sahi nikalta hai. Agricultural serfs, Conscripted infantry, Slaves ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Privileged merchant-traders and intelligence agents hi hai. Exam point: Privileged merchant-traders and intelligence agents - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In which geographic region of Central America did the Maya civilization primarily blossom?
qh: माया सभ्यता (Maya Civilization) मुख्य रूप से मेक्सिको के किस हिस्से में विकसित हुई थी?
e: Maya civilization Yucatan Peninsula aur uske adjacent Central American rain forests me phali-phooli. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki maya sabhyata (Maya Civilization) mukhy rup se meksiko ke kis hisse mein vikasit hui thi? Isliye antim jawab Yucatan Peninsula ke roop mein milta hai. Central volcanic desert, Northern arid plateaus, Pacific coastline anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Yucatan Peninsula hi milti hai. Exam point: Yucatan Peninsula - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which scientific fields represented the crowning intellectual achievements of the Mayas?
qh: माया सभ्यता की सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि किस क्षेत्र में मानी जाती है?
e: Mayans complex astronomical observations, zero-inclusive math aur precise solar calendar systems ke liye famous the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki maya sabhyata ki sabase badai upalabdhi kis kshetr mein mani jati hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Astronomy, Mathematics, and Calendar calculations sahi nikalta hai. Maritime trading ships, Horse pastoralism, Naval naval warfare is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Astronomy, Mathematics, and Calendar calculations hai. Exam point: Astronomy, Mathematics, and Calendar calculations - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Around which century did the Inca civilization begin its imperial rise in Peru?
qh: दक्षिण अमेरिका के पेरू में 'इंका' (Inca) सभ्यता का उदय किस शताब्दी में हुआ था?
e: 12th century me Manco Capac ne Cuzco valley me Inca civilization ki neenv rakhi thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki dakshin amerika ke peru mein 'inka' (Inca) sabhyata ka uday kis shatabdi mein hua tha? Isi aadhar par 12th century chuna jaata hai. 15th century, 9th century, 18th century is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 12th century hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 12th century - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the capital city of the Inca Empire located high in the Andes?
qh: इंका साम्राज्य की राजधानी क्या थी?
e: Cuzco Inca empire ka administrative, military aur religious capital tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki inka samrajy ki rajadhani kya thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Cuzco hi sahi baithta hai. Baaki vikalp - Lima, Mexico City, Tenochtitlan - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Cuzco hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Cuzco - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which ingenious knotted-cord recording system was utilized by the Incas for numerical accounting?
qh: इंका लोग डेटा रिकॉर्ड करने और संदेश भेजने के लिए धागों की गांठों वाली किस प्रणाली का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Quipu colored string cords me bandhi knots ka ek system tha jisse Incas census aur tax records maintain karte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki inka log deta rikord karane aur sandesh bhejane ke lie dhagon ki ganthon vali kis pranali ka upayog karate the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Quipu sahi nikalta hai. Cuneiform tablets, Papyrus scrolls, Hieroglyphs in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Quipu hi milti hai. Exam point: Quipu - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who is traditionally revered as the founding monarch of the Inca dynasty?
qh: इंका साम्राज्य के पहले शासक कौन थे जिन्होंने साम्राज्य विस्तार की नींव रखी?
e: Manco Capac ko Inca tradition me empire ka mythical first king aur founder maana jata hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki inka samrajy ke pahale shasak kaun the jinhonne samrajy vistar ki ninv rakhi? Isi karan se Manco Capac sahi uttar hai. Pachacuti, Huascar, Atahualpa mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Manco Capac hai. Exam point: Manco Capac - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the mandatory communal labour tax system called in the Inca Empire?
qh: इंका समाज में 'मिटा' (Mita) प्रणाली का क्या अर्थ था?
e: Mita ek mandatory public labour system tha jisme common citizens roads, bridges aur state fields par kaam karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki inka samaj mein 'mita' (Mita) pranali ka kya arth tha? Isi aadhar par Mandatory State Labour Service chuna jaata hai. Religious tithe, Commercial tariff, Marriage tax ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Mandatory State Labour Service baithta hai. Exam point: Mandatory State Labour Service - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which European colonial power led the military conquest and downfall of both the Aztec and Inca empires?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में एज़्टेक और इंका साम्राज्यों का विनाश किसके आक्रमण के कारण हुआ था?
e: Spanish conquistadors (Cortes ne Aztecs ko aur Pizarro ne Incas ko) ne 16th century me destroy kiya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki 16vin shatabdi mein ejatek aur inka samrajyon ka vinash kisake akraman ke karan hua tha? Isi karan se Spanish sahi uttar hai. Vikalp British, Portuguese, French bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Spanish hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Spanish - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The position of an Aztec agricultural serf resembled which social class of medieval Europe?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'सर्फ' (Serf) की स्थिति यूरोप के किस वर्ग के समान थी?
e: Aztec serfs noble estates se tied hote the aur agricultural labour provide karte the, jaise European serfs. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ejatek samaj mein 'sarph' (Serf) ki sthiti yurop ke kis varg ke saman thi? Isi karan se Bonded agricultural serfs sahi uttar hai. Feudal Lords, Chivalric knights, Guild masters is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Bonded agricultural serfs hai. Exam point: Bonded agricultural serfs - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which agricultural method did the Incas engineer to cultivate steep Andean slopes?
qh: इंका लोग खेती के लिए एंडीज पर्वतों पर किस तकनीक का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Andes ke steep pahado par soil erosion rokne aur farming ke liye Incas ne stone-walled Terraced fields banayi thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki inka log kheti ke lie endij parvaton par kis takanik ka upayog karate the? Isi karan se Terrace Farming sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Deep riverbed canal digging, Shifting slash-and-burn, Greenhouse cultivation bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Terrace Farming hi hai. Exam point: Terrace Farming - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What was the nature of the written script used by the Aztecs?
qh: एज़्टेक सभ्यता में 'पिक्टोग्राफिक' लिपि का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Pictographic glyphs representing events and sounds
e: Aztecs pictographic aur ideographic glyphs ke zariye codices me apni history aur administrative records depict karte the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ejatek sabhyata mein 'piktographik' lipi ka kya arth hai? Isi baat se Pictographic glyphs representing events and sounds sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Purely numerical tally, Alphabetic vowels, Absence of records chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Pictographic glyphs representing events and sounds hi hai. Exam point: Pictographic glyphs representing events and sounds - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What architectural stone monuments characterized major Mayan ceremonial centers like Tikal?
qh: माया सभ्यता में निर्मित विशाल पत्थर की संरचनाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Mayans ne ceremonial aur astronomical purposes ke liye steep-stepped stone Pyramids banaye the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki maya sabhyata mein nirmit vishal patthar ki sanrachanaon ko kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Stepped Pyramids sahi nikalta hai. Galti Stupas, Cathedrals, Ziggurats chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Stepped Pyramids hai. Exam point: Stepped Pyramids - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the social standing of military warriors in the Aztec Empire?
qh: एज़्टेक समाज में 'योद्धाओं' का दर्जा कैसा था?
e: Aztec society highly militaristic thi; successful warriors (Jaguar aur Eagle warriors) ko high prestige aur land milta tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ejatek samaj mein 'yoddhaon' ka darja kaisa tha? Isi tathya par Highly exalted and prestigious elite tika hua hai. Vikalp Menial servants, Lowest outcast rank, Stateless wanderers bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Highly exalted and prestigious elite baithta hai. Exam point: Highly exalted and prestigious elite - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who authored the monumental encyclopedic work 'Natural History' (Naturalis Historia) during the Roman era?
qh: 1800 साल पहले लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'प्राकृतिक इतिहास' (Natural History) के लेखक कौन थे?
e: Roman scholar Pliny the Elder ne 1st century CE me famous encyclopedia 'Natural History' likhi thi. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki 1800 sal pahale likhi gai prasiddh pustak 'prakritik itihas' (Natural History) ke lekhak kaun the? Isi karan se Pliny the Elder sahi uttar hai. Kalidasa, Marc Bloch, Tacitus is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Pliny the Elder hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Pliny the Elder - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Across which three continents was the Roman Empire geographically spread at its peak?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य का विस्तार किन तीन महाद्वीपों में था?
e: Roman Empire Europe, North Africa aur West Asia ke pure Mediterranean perimeter me phaila hua tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki roman samrajy ka vistar kin tin mahadvipon mein tha? In tathyon ke chalte Asia, Europe, and Africa hi sahi hai. Vikalp Europe, Africa, and Australia, America, Africa, and Antarctica, Asia, Europe, and America bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Asia, Europe, and Africa hi milti hai. Exam point: Asia, Europe, and Africa - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which body of water was metaphorically described as the 'Heart of the Roman Empire'?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य का हृदय किसे कहा जाता था?
e: Mediterranean Sea Roman empire ke center me tha aur empire ki connectivity aur trade ka main lifeline tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki roman samrajy ka hriday kise kaha jata tha? Isi karan se Mediterranean Sea sahi uttar hai. Caspian Sea, Red Sea, Black Sea ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Mediterranean Sea hi hai. Exam point: Mediterranean Sea - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two European rivers marked the fortified northern frontiers of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की उत्तरी सीमा कौन सी नदियाँ बनाती थीं?
e: Rhine aur Danube rivers Roman empire ki northern natural boundary banati thi jo use Germanic tribes se alag karti thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki roman samrajy ki uttari sima kaun si nadiyan banati thin? Isi tathya par Rhine and Danube tika hua hai. Ganga and Indus, Nile and Tigris, Mississippi and Amazon alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Rhine and Danube hi milti hai. Exam point: Rhine and Danube - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which geographical desert formed the southern natural boundary of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दक्षिणी सीमा पर कौन सा विशाल मरुस्थल था?
e: North Africa me Sahara Desert Roman empire ki southern limit ko define karta tha. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki roman samrajy ki dakshini sima par kaun sa vishal marusthal tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Sahara Desert hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Kalahari Desert, Gobi Desert, Thar Desert ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Sahara Desert baithta hai. Exam point: Sahara Desert - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who established the Roman Principate and reigned as the first Roman Emperor in 27 BCE?
qh: प्रथम रोमन सम्राट कौन था जिसने 27 ईसा पूर्व में शासन संभाला?
e: Augustus (Octavian) ne 27 BCE me Republic ko replace karke first Roman imperial regime (Principate) banaya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki pratham roman samrat kaun tha jisane 27 isa purv mein shasan sanbhala? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Augustus hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Constantine, Julius Caesar, Nero in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Augustus hi hai. Exam point: Augustus - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What modest title meaning 'leading citizen' did Augustus officially adopt to appease the Senate?
qh: अगस्तस ने स्वयं को किस नाम से पुकारना पसंद किया?
e: Augustus ne monarchical title lene ke bajay 'Princeps' (leading citizen) kehna pasand kiya taaki Senate insult feel na kare. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki agastas ne svayan ko kis nam se pukarana pasand kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Princeps hi sahi baithta hai. Caliph, Dictator, Imperator Rex is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Princeps hi hai. Exam point: Princeps - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the three foundational political pillars of the Roman governance system?
qh: रोमन राजनीतिक व्यवस्था के तीन मुख्य स्तंभ कौन से थे?
e: Roman state ka political power balance Emperor, Senate (aristocracy) aur paid professional Army ke beech divided tha. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki roman rajanitik vyavastha ke tin mukhy stanbh kaun se the? Isi baat se Emperor, Senate, and Army sahi sabit hota hai. Galti Emperor, Priesthood, and Peasantry, Monarch, Ministers, and Public, Merchants, Workers, and Soldiers chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Emperor, Senate, and Army hai. Exam point: Emperor, Senate, and Army - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What crucial structural feature distinguished the Roman army from that of the rival Persian (Iranian) Empire?
qh: रोमन सेना की प्रमुख विशेषता क्या थी, जो उसे ईरान से अलग करती थी?
o: It relied purely on seasonal peasant levies
It was a standing, professional, salaried army
e: Rome ke paas regular salaried professional standing army thi jisme soldiers ko 25 years minimum service deni padti thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki roman sena ki pramukh visheshata kya thi, jo use iran se alag karati thi? Isliye antim jawab It was a standing, professional, salaried army ke roop mein milta hai. It conscripted only mercenaries, It was entirely non-standing, It relied purely on seasonal peasant levies anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab It was a standing, professional, salaried army hai. Exam point: It was a standing, professional, salaried army - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which social class dominated the membership of the Roman Senate?
qh: रोम में 'सीनेट' (Senate) मुख्य रूप से किन लोगों की संस्था थी?
e: Senate me Roman world ke sabse wealthy landed families aur elite patricians ka representation hota tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rom mein 'sinet' (Senate) mukhy rup se kin logon ki sanstha thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Wealthy landed aristocracy nikalta hai. Imperial freedmen, Urban artisans, Foreign diplomats alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Wealthy landed aristocracy hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Wealthy landed aristocracy - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How is the historical reign of Emperor Augustus uniquely remembered in Roman annals?
qh: अगस्तस के शासनकाल को रोमन इतिहास में किस रूप में याद किया जाता है?
e: Civil wars ke baad Augustus ka rule internal stability aur peace laya, jise Pax Romana (Roman Peace) kehte hain. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki agastas ke shasanakal ko roman itihas mein kis rup mein yad kiya jata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Pax Romana (Age of Peace) nikalta hai. Period of Religious Turmoil, The Great Famine, Age of Endless Expansion alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Pax Romana (Age of Peace) hi hai. Exam point: Pax Romana (Age of Peace) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which specific ceramic containers were manufactured to transport wine and olive oil across Rome?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में तरल पदार्थों (वाइन, तेल) के परिवहन के लिए किन मटकों का उपयोग किया जाता था?
e: Liquid commodities jaise wine aur oil ko do-handle wale ceramic jars me transport karte the jinhe Amphorae kehte hain. Is sawaal mein Amphorae ki baat hai. Isi karan se Amphorae sahi uttar hai. Terra pots, Glass carboys, Bronze flagons is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Amphorae hi milti hai. Exam point: Amphorae - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How was the 'Nuclear Family' structure typical in Roman civil society?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'एकल परिवार' (Nuclear Family) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Adult sons living apart from their parents' household
e: Roman society me adult married sons apne parents ke sath nahi rehte the, aur nuclear family structure predominant tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki roman samaj mein 'ekal parivar' (Nuclear Family) ka kya arth tha? Isi tathya par Adult sons living apart from their parents'... tika hua hai. Patriarchal clans living together, Entire villages sharing homes, Siblings holding joint communal households is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Adult sons living apart from their parents'... hi hai. Exam point: Adult sons living apart from their parents'... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the institutional status of 'Slavery' within the economic fabric of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'दासता' (Slavery) की स्थिति क्या थी?
o: A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital investment
e: Rome me slavery ek deep-rooted economic institution thi jahan slaves ko agriculture, mines aur trade me capital investment maana jata tha. Is prashn ka kendra A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital investment hai. Isi baat se A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital investment sahi sabit hota hai. Legally banned under all circumstances, Confined solely to naval rowers, Slaves received regular state salaries mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital investment hi milti hai. Exam point: A deeply entrenched economic institution and capital... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pure gold coin was introduced by Emperor Constantine that became a stable standard currency?
qh: रोम के सम्राट कांसटेनटाइन ने कौन सा नया सोने का सिक्का चलाया था?
e: Constantine ne 4.5 grams pure gold ka coin 'Solidus' introduce kiya jo sadiyon tak stable currency bana raha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki rom ke samrat kansatenatain ne kaun sa naya sone ka sikka chalaya tha? Isi karan se Solidus sahi uttar hai. Drachma, Aureus, Denarius ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Solidus hi milti hai. Exam point: Solidus - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which city was founded by Constantine as the new eastern administrative capital of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दूसरी राजधानी कौन सी बनाई गई थी?
e: Constantine ne Byzantium ke sthan par Constantinople (modern Istanbul) ko new imperial capital banaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki roman samrajy ki dusari rajadhani kaun si banai gai thi? Isliye antim jawab Constantinople ke roop mein milta hai. Ravenna, Alexandria, Antioch mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Constantinople hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Constantinople - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which groups invaded and breached the northern frontiers during the Third Century Crisis in Rome?
qh: तीसरी शताब्दी के संकट के दौरान रोम पर आक्रमण करने वाले कबीलों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: 3rd century CE me Rhine aur Danube frontiers par Goths, Alamanni aur Franks jaise Germanic tribes ne repeated attacks kiye. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki tisari shatabdi ke sankat ke dauran rom par akraman karane vale kabilon ko kya kaha jata tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Germanic tribes (Barbarians) nikalta hai. Mongols, Vikings, Ottomans mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Germanic tribes (Barbarians) hai. Exam point: Germanic tribes (Barbarians) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which statement accurately describes the literacy pattern across the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में साक्षरता की दर के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes
Only the imperial family could read
Literacy was strictly forbidden for women
Universal full literacy across all provinces
e: Literacy har province aur class me alag thi; military camps aur Pompeii jaise urban towns me high casual literacy ke proofs milte hain. Is prashn ka vishay Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes nikalta hai. Galti Only the imperial family could read, Literacy was strictly forbidden for women, Universal full literacy across all provinces chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Casual literacy that varied sharply across regions and classes - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What archaeological evidence proves widespread casual literacy among ordinary citizens in Pompeii?
qh: पोम्पेई (Pompeii) शहर में साक्षरता का प्रमाण कहाँ मिलता है?
o: Graffiti, trade advertisements, and notices painted on street walls
e: Pompeii ke city walls par election advertisements, personal graffiti aur price lists milti hain jo common literacy prove karti hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki pompei (Pompeii) shahar mein saksharata ka praman kahan milata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Graffiti, trade advertisements, and notices painted on street walls nikalta hai. Gold inscribed plates, Clay cuneiform bricks, Printed encyclopedias is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Graffiti, trade advertisements, and notices painted on street walls hai. Exam point: Graffiti, trade advertisements, and notices painted on street walls - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the two primary administrative and literary languages of the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य की दो आधिकारिक प्रशासनिक भाषाएँ कौन सी थीं?
e: Western empire me Latin language dominate karti thi jabki Eastern Mediterranean provinces me Greek language administration ki bhasha thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki roman samrajy ki do adhikarik prashasanik bhashaen kaun si thin? Isi tathya par Latin and Greek tika hua hai. French and German, English and Latin, Aramaic and Hebrew is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Latin and Greek hi milti hai. Exam point: Latin and Greek - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Thousands of surviving bureaucratic documents from Roman Egypt written on reeds are called:
qh: मिस्र (Egypt) से प्राप्त वे दस्तावेज़ जो 'पपायरस' पर लिखे गए थे, उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
e: Papyrus plant ke fibers se bane sheets par likhe gaye letters aur legal contracts ko Papyri kehte hain. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki misr (Egypt) se prapt ve dastavej jo 'papayaras' par likhe gae the, unhein kya kahate hain? Isi karan se Papyri sahi uttar hai. Codices, Epigraphs, Scrolls is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Papyri hi milti hai. Exam point: Papyri - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What property rights did women legally retain under classical Roman law?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में महिलाओं को किस प्रकार के कानूनी अधिकार प्राप्त थे?
o: Retained ownership of natal property and legal rights to manage independent estates
Zero rights with complete forfeiture to husbands
Right to serve in the imperial legions
e: Roman women marriage ke baad bhi apne father ki property ki legal heir rehti thi aur independent property manage kar sakti thi. Is prashn ka dayra Retained ownership of natal property and legal rights to manage independent estates tak phaila hua hai. Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Retained ownership of natal property and legal rights to manage independent estates hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Universal political voting franchise, Zero rights with complete forfeiture to husbands, Right to serve in the imperial legions chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Retained ownership of natal property and legal rights to manage independent estates hai. Exam point: Retained ownership of natal property and legal... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: How did marriage and divorce laws function in Roman civil society?
qh: रोम में 'तलाक' (Divorce) लेना कैसा था?
o: Relatively easy, requiring only a formal notice of intent from either spouse
Required direct approval from the Emperor
Subjected spouses to heavy criminal penalties
e: Roman law me divorce lena aasan tha; husband ya wife me se koi bhi notice of intent dekar marriage dissolve kar sakta tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rom mein 'talak' (Divorce) lena kaisa tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Relatively easy, requiring only a formal notice... sahi nikalta hai. Required direct approval from the Emperor, Subjected spouses to heavy criminal penalties, Legally prohibited by civil courts in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Relatively easy, requiring only a formal notice of intent from either spouse hi hai. Exam point: Relatively easy, requiring only a formal notice of intent from either spouse - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Sasanian monarch of Iran claimed to have annihilated a Roman army of 60,000 soldiers?
qh: ईरान के ससानी वंश के किस राजा ने 60,000 रोमन सेना को हराने का दावा किया था?
e: Sasanian king Shapur I ne 3rd century me Roman forces ko buri tarah defeat karke Antioch capture karne ka claim kiya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki iran ke sasani vansh ke kis raja ne 60,000 roman sena ko harane ka dava kiya tha? Isi karan se Shapur I sahi uttar hai. Darius I, Xerxes, Cyrus the Great alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Shapur I hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Shapur I - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What major territorial policy was implemented by Emperor Diocletian to stabilize the Roman Empire?
qh: सम्राट डायोक्लेशियन (Diocletian) ने साम्राज्य को बचाने के लिए क्या प्रमुख सुधार किया?
o: Cut losses by abandoning territories of minimal strategic and economic value
e: Diocletian ne empire ko manageable banane ke liye un frontiers ko abandon kiya jo revenue nahi dete the aur borders ko fortify kiya. Prashn yah batata hai ki samrat dayokleshiyan (Diocletian) ne samrajy ko bachane ke lie kya pramukh sudhar kiya? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Cut losses by abandoning territories of minimal strategic and economic value hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Outlawed Roman polytheism, Abolished all taxes, Disbanded the military legions chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Cut losses by abandoning territories of minimal strategic and economic value hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Cut losses by abandoning territories of minimal... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the ubiquitous 'Public Baths' represent in Roman urban culture?
qh: रोम में 'सार्वजनिक स्नानगृह' (Public Baths) किसका प्रतीक थे?
o: Hallmark of sophisticated civic urban lifestyle and social leisure
e: Public baths Roman city life ka sabse distinctive cultural recreation feature the jo civic identity represent karte the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki rom mein 'sarvajanik snanagrih' (Public Baths) kisaka pratik the? Isi karan se Hallmark of sophisticated civic urban lifestyle and social leisure sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Ritualistic monastic austerity, Industrial slave washing quarters, Military confinement compounds bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Hallmark of sophisticated civic urban lifestyle and social leisure hi hai. Exam point: Hallmark of sophisticated civic urban lifestyle and social leisure - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the enduring political significance of the established tradition of Roman Civil Law?
qh: रोमन कानून की परंपरा (Roman Law) का मुख्य महत्व क्या था?
o: It acted as a constitutional check against arbitrary imperial despotism
It was completely abolished during Late Antiquity
It exclusively served the interest of the plebeians
e: Roman legal tradition itni strong thi ki wo autocrat emperors ko bhi rule of law ke tahat bound rakhti thi. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki roman kanun ki paranpara (Roman Law) ka mukhy mahatv kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par It acted as a constitutional check against arbitrary imperial despotism hi sahi baithta hai. It remained unwritten and verbal, It was completely abolished during Late Antiquity, It exclusively served the interest of the plebeians ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan It acted as a constitutional check against... hi milti hai. Exam point: It acted as a constitutional check against arbitrary imperial despotism - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Roman Emperor officially converted to Christianity and provided it with state patronage?
qh: सम्राट कांसटेनटाइन ने किस धर्म को आधिकारिक संरक्षण दिया?
e: Constantine ne 4th century CE me Christianity ko adopt kiya aur use imperial state patronage provide kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki samrat kansatenatain ne kis dharm ko adhikarik sanrakshan diya? Isi karan se Christianity sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Buddhism, Judaism, Islam - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Christianity hi milti hai. Exam point: Christianity - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In the context of the Late Roman Empire, who were designated as 'Pagans'?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'पेगन' (Pagan) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Non-Christian followers of polytheistic traditional religions
e: Christianity spread hone ke baad un traditional polytheist logo ko 'Pagan' kaha gaya jo purane devtaon ki puja karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki roman samaj mein 'pegan' (Pagan) shabd ka prayog kisake lie kiya jata tha? In tathyon ke chalte Non-Christian followers of polytheistic traditional religions hi sahi hai. Legionary centurions, Persian imperial couriers, Christian bishops in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Non-Christian followers of polytheistic traditional religions hi milti hai. Exam point: Non-Christian followers of polytheistic traditional religions - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which lost western territories did Emperor Justinian attempt to reconquer in the 6th century?
qh: जस्टिनियन (Justinian) ने साम्राज्य के किस हिस्से को वापस जीतने का प्रयास किया था?
e: 6th century me Byzantine Emperor Justinian ne Vandals aur Ostrogoths se North Africa aur Italy recapture karne ki koshish ki. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki jastiniyan (Justinian) ne samrajy ke kis hisse ko vapas jitane ka prayas kiya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki North Africa and Italy sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Russia, China, India - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan North Africa and Italy hi milti hai. Exam point: North Africa and Italy - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What external geopolitical pressure directly accelerated the fragmentation of the Western Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य के पतन का एक मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations
Drying up of the Nile river
e: Germanic tribes (Visigoths, Vandals) aur Huns ke continuous pressure ne Western Roman Empire ko disintegrate kar diya. Is prashn ka dayra Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations tak phaila hua hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations nikalta hai. Total extinction of Mediterranean fish, Depletion of ocean waters, Drying up of the Nile river alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Repeated incursions and settlements by Germanic and Central Asian confederations - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which 7th-century geopolitical revolution permanently dismantled Roman hegemony in the Near East and North Africa?
qh: सातवीं शताब्दी में किस नए राजनीतिक और धार्मिक उदय ने रोमन साम्राज्य को अंतिम रूप से प्रभावित किया?
e: 7th century me Arabian Peninsula se Islamic Caliphate ke rise ne Roman (Byzantine) empire ke eastern provinces capture kar liye. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki satavin shatabdi mein kis nae rajanitik aur dharmik uday ne roman samrajy ko antim rup se prabhavit kiya? Isi karan se Rise of the Islamic Caliphate sahi uttar hai. Spread of Sikhism, Mongol expansion, Spread of Buddhism mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Rise of the Islamic Caliphate hai. Exam point: Rise of the Islamic Caliphate - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which period in Roman imperial history is categorized as the 'Early Empire'?
qh: रोमन इतिहास में 'अर्ली एम्पायर' (Early Empire) किस काल को कहा जाता है?
o: The reign of Julius Caesar alone
From the 4th to the 7th century CE
The era following the Arab conquests
From Augustus to the 3rd century CE
e: 27 BCE me Augustus ke rule se lekar 3rd century crisis tak ke era ko Early Empire maana jata hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki roman itihas mein 'arli empayar' (Early Empire) kis kal ko kaha jata hai? Isliye antim jawab From Augustus to the 3rd century CE ke roop mein milta hai. The reign of Julius Caesar alone, From the 4th to the 7th century CE, The era following the Arab conquests in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab From Augustus to the 3rd century CE hai. Exam point: From Augustus to the 3rd century CE - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Why did the Late Roman Empire transition its currency base from silver to gold?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'सिल्वर बेस्ट' करेंसी के स्थान पर 'गोल्ड बेस्ट' करेंसी क्यों लाई गई?
e: Spain ki silver mines exhaust hone ki wajah se silver denarius debase ho gaya tha, isliye Constantine ne gold Solidus ko base banaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki roman samrajy mein 'silvar best' kareinsi ke sthan par 'gold best' kareinsi kyon lai gai? In tathyon ke chalte Exhaustion of Spanish silver mines hi sahi hai. Vikalp Mediterranean maritime trade halted, Gold became cheaper than copper, The emperor disliked silver ornaments bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Exhaustion of Spanish silver mines hi milti hai. Exam point: Exhaustion of Spanish silver mines - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the estimated annual estate income enjoyed by the grand senatorial families in Late Rome?
qh: रोमन अभिजात वर्ग (Aristocracy) की वार्षिक आय कितनी बताई गई है?
e: Historian Olympiodorus ke mutabik richest senatorial families ko unke huge estates se yearly 4,000 lbs gold tak revenue milta tha.
