Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki roman abhijat varg (Aristocracy) ki varshik ay kitani batai gai hai? Isi baat se Up to 4,000 lbs of gold sahi sabit hota hai. 10 million copper asses, 100 lbs of gold, Negligible subsistence output alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Up to 4,000 lbs of gold hi hai. Exam point: Up to 4,000 lbs of gold - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who constituted the 'Equites' (Knights) class in Roman society?
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'नाइट्स' (Knights) या अश्वारोही वर्ग कौन थे?
o: Wealthy equestrian landowners, business entrepreneurs, and bankers
e: Equites (Knights) senators ke baad doosra wealthy aristocracy group tha jo business, trade aur tax-farming me involved tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki roman samrajy mein 'naits' (Knights) ya ashvarohi varg kaun the? Isi karan se Wealthy equestrian landowners, business entrepreneurs, and bankers sahi uttar hai. Galti Agricultural serfs, Foreign provincial slaves, Tenant farmers chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Wealthy equestrian landowners, business entrepreneurs, and bankers hi hai. Exam point: Wealthy equestrian landowners, business entrepreneurs, and bankers - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What practice was commonly used by Roman estate owners to control and identify manual workers and slaves?
qh: रोम में 'मज़दूरों' पर नियंत्रण रखने के लिए सम्राटों और स्वामियों ने क्या किया था?
e: Estates aur factories me runaway slaves aur workers ko identify karne ke liye unpar hot iron se branding ki jaati thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki rom mein 'majaduron' par niyantran rakhane ke lie samraton aur svamiyon ne kya kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Physical branding and tattooing nikalta hai. Enrolling them into diplomatic corps, Providing paid sabbatical leaves, Promoting all to the senate is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Physical branding and tattooing hai. Exam point: Physical branding and tattooing - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The historical era spanning from the 4th to the 7th centuries CE in the Roman world is designated as:
qh: रोमन साम्राज्य में 'लेट एंटीक्विटी' (Late Antiquity) का काल कौन सा है?
e: Constantine ke rise se lekar Islamic conquest tak (4th se 7th century CE) ke period ko Late Antiquity bolte hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki roman samrajy mein 'let entikviti' (Late Antiquity) ka kal kaun sa hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Late Antiquity nikalta hai. Classical Principate, Early Republic, High Hellenistic Age is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Late Antiquity hi hai. Exam point: Late Antiquity - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which specific standardized amphora container was utilized to export Spanish olive oil across the Roman world?
qh: स्पेनिश ऑलिव ऑयल (जैतून का तेल) किन बर्तनों में ले जाया जाता था?
e: Spanish olive oil predominantly 'Dressel 20' type heavy globular amphorae me transport hota tha jiske shards Monte Testaccio par mile hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki spenish oliv oyal (jaitun ka tel) kin bartanon mein le jaya jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Dressel 20 sahi hai. Amphora Type A, Samian bowl, Pebble jar is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Dressel 20 baithta hai. Exam point: Dressel 20 - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Why did Emperor Gallienus exclude senators from holding high military commands?
qh: रोमन सम्राट 'गैलिएनस' (Gallienus) ने सीनेटर्स को सेना से क्यों हटाया?
o: To prevent senatorial coups and consolidate direct imperial control over the army
e: Gallienus ne senators ko command se baahar kar diya taaki senatorial aristocracy army ko use karke throne capture na kar sake. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki roman samrat 'gailienas' (Gallienus) ne sinetars ko sena se kyon hataya? Isliye sahi nateeja To prevent senatorial coups and consolidate direct imperial control over the army nikalta hai. Vikalp The legions were disbanded, Senators were physically frail, Senators refused to carry swords bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar To prevent senatorial coups and consolidate direct... hi hai. Exam point: To prevent senatorial coups and consolidate direct imperial control over the army - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who were classified under the legal category of 'Humiliores' in the Roman social order?
qh: रोमन समाज में 'निम्नतर वर्ग' (Humiliores) में कौन शामिल थे?
o: Rural tenant labourers, wage earners, and the urban poor
e: Roman legal system me elite honestiores ke opposite lower working class, peasants aur poor citizens ko Humiliores kaha jata tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki roman samaj mein 'nimnatar varg' (Humiliores) mein kaun shamil the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Rural tenant labourers, wage earners, and the urban poor hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti Imperial senatorial dynasty, High priests of Apollo, Equestrian civil officers chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Rural tenant labourers, wage earners, and the urban poor hi hai. Exam point: Rural tenant labourers, wage earners, and the... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The word 'Mesopotamia' is synthesized from which two Greek root words?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया शब्द किन दो ग्रीक शब्दों से मिलकर बना है?
e: Greek language me 'Mesos' ka matlab middle (beech) aur 'Potamos' ka matlab river hota hai (do nadiyo ke beech ki zameen). Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mesopotamiya shabd kin do grik shabdon se milakar bana hai? Isi tathya par Mesos and Potamos tika hua hai. Mesos and Hippos, Potamos and Polis, Mesos and Oros is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Mesos and Potamos hi milti hai. Exam point: Mesos and Potamos - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Between which two legendary rivers did the Mesopotamian civilization flourish?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सभ्यता किन दो नदियों के बीच विकसित हुई थी?
e: Mesopotamia modern Iraq me Tigris (Dajla) aur Euphrates (Furat) nadiyo ke beech ka fertile alluvial land tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya ki sabhyata kin do nadiyon ke bich vikasit hui thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Tigris and Euphrates hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Yellow River and Yangtze, Nile and Indus, Ganga and Yamuna mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Tigris and Euphrates hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Tigris and Euphrates - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What physical material served as the medium for writing in ancient Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में लेखन कला की शुरुआत के लिए लोग किस सामग्री का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Mesopotamians gili mitti (clay) ki tablets par reed stylus se wedge-shaped signs banate the aur dhoop me sukha kar bake karte the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki mesopotamiya mein lekhan kala ki shuruat ke lie log kis samagri ka upayog karate the? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Wet Clay Tablets hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Woven linen cloth, Parchment paper, Palm leaves is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Wet Clay Tablets hai. Exam point: Wet Clay Tablets - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which is recognized as the earliest recorded language of Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सबसे पुरानी ज्ञात भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Mesopotamia me sabse pehle likhi jaane wali bhasha Sumerian thi, jise baad me Akkadian ne replace kiya. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya ki sabase purani jnat bhasha kaun si thi? Isi karan se Sumerian sahi uttar hai. Aramaic, Hebrew, Akkadian in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Sumerian hi milti hai. Exam point: Sumerian - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the wedge-shaped script developed in ancient Mesopotamia called?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की लिपि को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Latin word 'Cuneus' (wedge) se Cuneiform bana hai, jiska matlab keel ya khunti ke aakar ke signs wali script hota hai. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya ki lipi ko kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se Cuneiform sahi uttar hai. Kharosthi, Brahmi, Hieroglyphic mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Cuneiform baithta hai. Exam point: Cuneiform - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What scientific branch was highly advanced in Mesopotamia, marked by astronomical solar and lunar observations?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग आकाश में तारों और ग्रहों की स्थिति का अध्ययन करते थे, इसे क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Mesopotamians ne solar/lunar eclipses aur planetary movements ka systematic record rakha, jo Astronomy me landmark bana. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya ke log akash mein taron aur grahon ki sthiti ka adhyayan karate the, ise kya kaha jata hai? Isi karan se Astronomy sahi uttar hai. Theoretical algebra, Botany, Topography alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Astronomy baithta hai. Exam point: Astronomy - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What were the monumental stepped temple towers called in ancient Mesopotamian cities?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के मंदिरों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Mesopotamian city ke patron god ke unche stepped terrace-like mud brick temple structure ko Ziggurat bolte the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mesopotamiya ke mandiron ko kya kaha jata tha? Isliye antim jawab Ziggurats ke roop mein milta hai. Pagodas, Chaityas, Pyramids ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Ziggurats hi hai. Exam point: Ziggurats - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The ancient southern city of Ur was dedicated to the worship of which patron deity?
qh: उर (Ur) शहर मेसोपोटामिया के किस देवता को समर्पित था?
e: Ur south Mesopotamia ka major city-state tha jo Moon God (Nanna/Sin) ko dedicate kiya gaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki ur (Ur) shahar mesopotamiya ke kis devata ko samarpit tha? Isi karan se Moon God (Nanna) sahi uttar hai. Storm God (Enlil), Sun God (Shamash), Goddess of Love (Inanna) mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Moon God (Nanna) baithta hai. Exam point: Moon God (Nanna) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Inanna was revered as the Mesopotamian goddess of which two domains?
qh: इन्नाना (Inanna) मेसोपोटामिया में किसकी देवी मानी जाती थी?
e: Uruk me Inanna ko Love aur War ki supreme goddess ke roop me pooja jata tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki innana (Inanna) mesopotamiya mein kisaki devi mani jati thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Love and War sahi nikalta hai. Harvest and grain, Wisdom and rivers, Underworld death is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Love and War hai. Exam point: Love and War - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: At which Mesopotamian urban center was the sculpted marble 'Warka Head' discovered?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'वारका शीर्ष' (Warka Head) कहाँ से मिला है?
e: Pure white marble se carve kiya gaya famous female face sculpture 'Warka Head' Uruk city se discover hua tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki mesopotamiya mein 'varaka shirsh' (Warka Head) kahan se mila hai? Isi aadhar par Uruk chuna jaata hai. Nineveh, Ur, Mari alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Uruk hi hai. Exam point: Uruk - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Mesopotamian city-state on the Euphrates prospered primarily as a strategic commercial trading hub?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया का वह कौन सा शहर था जो केवल व्यापारिक गतिविधियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Mari Euphrates ke trade route par transit center tha jo timber, copper, tin aur wine ke commercial trade se rich bana. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mesopotamiya ka vah kaun sa shahar tha jo keval vyaparik gatividhiyon ke lie prasiddh tha? Isliye antim jawab Mari ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Ur, Kish, Akkad chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Mari hi hai. Exam point: Mari - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the normative family structure documented in Mesopotamian civil law tablets?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के समाज में किस प्रकार के परिवार का चलन था?
e: Mesopotamian legal records show karte hain ki wahan married couple aur unke bachhon wali Nuclear family standard maani jaati thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mesopotamiya ke samaj mein kis prakar ke parivar ka chalan tha? Isi aadhar par Nuclear Family chuna jaata hai. Joint agrarian clan, Matriarchal tribe, Communal boarding anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Nuclear Family hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Nuclear Family - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which civilization was the heroic 12-tablet 'Epic of Gilgamesh' composed?
qh: गिलगमेश (Gilgamesh) महाकाव्य की रचना किस सभ्यता में हुई थी?
e: Uruk ke legendary ruler Gilgamesh ki immortality search par based Epic of Gilgamesh Mesopotamia ka master literary work hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki gilagamesh (Gilgamesh) mahakavy ki rachana kis sabhyata mein hui thi? Isi karan se Mesopotamia sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Classical Greece, Indus Valley, Ancient Egypt bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Mesopotamia sahi hai. Exam point: Mesopotamia - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Assyrian king established a celebrated royal library of cuneiform tablets at Nineveh?
qh: निनवे (Nineveh) में एक विशाल पुस्तकालय की स्थापना किस राजा ने की थी?
e: Assyrian king Assurbanipal ne Nineveh me thousands of cuneiform literary aur scientific tablets collect karke grand library banayi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ninave (Nineveh) mein ek vishal pustakalay ki sthapana kis raja ne ki thi? Isi tathya par Assurbanipal tika hua hai. Vikalp Gilgamesh, Enmerkar, Sargon of Akkad bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Assurbanipal hai. Exam point: Assurbanipal - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What sexagesimal base did Mesopotamians invent to divide one hour into minutes and a circle into degrees?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में समय गणना के लिए 1 घंटे को कितने मिनटों में बांटा गया था?
e: Mesopotamians ne base-60 sexagesimal math system diya jisse 1 hour = 60 mins aur circle = 360 ka division define hua. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya mein samay ganana ke lie 1 ghante ko kitane minaton mein banta gaya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja 60 nikalta hai. 50, 100, 24 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 60 hai. Exam point: 60 - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Why did agrarian populations situated downstream along the Euphrates frequently suffer water shortages?
qh: फरात नदी के 'डाउनस्ट्रीम' (निचले हिस्से) के लोगों को पानी की समस्या क्यों होती थी?
o: Upstream communities diverted too much water into their own field channels
e: Upstream settlements zyada irrigation ke liye channels se paani divert kar lete the, jisse downstream wale logo ko water scarcity hoti thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki pharat nadi ke 'daunastrim' (nichale hisse) ke logon ko pani ki samasya kyon hoti thi? Isi aadhar par Upstream communities diverted too much water into their own field channels chuna jaata hai. Vikalp Perennial sea water contamination, Total subterranean evaporation, Tectonic uplifting of river mouth bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Upstream communities diverted too much water into their own field channels hi hai. Exam point: Upstream communities diverted too much water into their own field channels - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Mesopotamian city excavated by Sir Leonard Woolley was notorious for narrow, winding, unpaved streets?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के किस शहर की गलियां बहुत संकरी और टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी पाई गई हैं?
e: Ur city me roads narrow, unpaved aur winding thi jisse wheeled carts ghar tak nahi ja sakti thi aur pack animals use hote the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mesopotamiya ke kis shahar ki galiyan bahut sankari aur tedhai-medhai pai gai hain? Isliye antim jawab Ur ke roop mein milta hai. Mari, Harappa, Babylon ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Ur hi hai. Exam point: Ur - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What physical geometric shape was characteristic of Mesopotamian stone rolling seals?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सील (Mohar) का आकार कैसा होता था?
e: Mesopotamians cylindrical stone seals banate the jinko gili mitti ki tablet par roll karke continuous impression stamp kiya jata tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya ki sil (Mohar) ka akar kaisa hota tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Cylindrical hi sahi baithta hai. Rectangular flat, Triangular wedge, Flat square in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Cylindrical hi hai. Exam point: Cylindrical - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What represents the most enduring scientific contribution of Mesopotamia to the discipline of mathematics?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया का गणित के क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ा योगदान क्या माना जाता है?
o: Compilation of multiplication, square, square root, and compound interest tables
e: Mesopotamians ne clay tablets par complex multiplication tables, squares, square roots aur compound interest ke tables banaye the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya ka ganit ke kshetr mein sabase bada yogadan kya mana jata hai? Yahi wajah hai ki Compilation of multiplication, square, square root, and compound interest tables sahi hai. Decimal zero notation, Calculus notation, Spherical geometry algorithms in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Compilation of multiplication, square, square root, and compound interest tables hai. Exam point: Compilation of multiplication, square, square root, and... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The ruling kings of the trade-centric city-state of Mari belonged to which ethnic community?
qh: मारी के राजा किस समुदाय से संबंधित थे?
e: Mari ke kings Amorite pastoral nomadic background se the aur unke culture me pastoral aur agrarian traits combine the. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki mari ke raja kis samuday se sanbandhit the? Isi karan se Amorite sahi uttar hai. Galti Hittite, Egyptian, Pure Sumerian chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Amorite hai. Exam point: Amorite - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What economic activity was predominantly carried out in the arid Steppe grasslands of Northern Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में स्टेपी (Steppe) क्षेत्र का मुख्य उपयोग क्या था?
e: North Mesopotamia ke Steppe grasslands me sheep aur goats ki pastoral herding hi primary livelihood ka resource thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya mein stepi (Steppe) kshetr ka mukhy upayog kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Pastoral animal herding (sheep and goats) sahi nikalta hai. Marine fishing, Wet paddy cultivation, Deep copper mining ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Pastoral animal herding (sheep and goats) hi milti hai. Exam point: Pastoral animal herding (sheep and goats) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: According to ancient Sumerian epic poetry, King Enmerkar dispatched his messenger to which mountain city for lapis lazuli?
qh: राजा एनमर्कर ने अपने दूत को किस शहर के पास कीमती पत्थर लेने भेजा था?
e: Uruk ke ruler Enmerkar ne Lapis Lazuli aur silver obtain karne ke liye apne messenger ko Aratta city bheja tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki raja enamarkar ne apane dut ko kis shahar ke pas kimati patthar lene bheja tha? Isi baat se Aratta sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp Mari, Nineveh, Ur bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Aratta hai. Exam point: Aratta - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which metal alloy defined the early urban technology and tools of Mesopotamian civilization?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग किस धातु का उपयोग औजार बनाने के लिए करने लगे थे?
e: Mesopotamia Bronze Age society thi jahan Copper aur Tin ko melt karke hard Bronze alloy tools banaye jaate the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya ke log kis dhatu ka upayog aujar banane ke lie karane lage the? Isi baat se Bronze (Copper + Tin) sahi sabit hota hai. Stainless Steel, Smelted Iron, Aluminum is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Bronze (Copper + Tin) hai. Exam point: Bronze (Copper + Tin) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the subject matter recorded on the 'Omen Tablets' of Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'ओमेन टैबलेट' (Omen Tablet) का संबंध किससे था?
o: Superstitious omens, architectural beliefs, and astrological portents
e: Omen tablets par daily life ke shagun, ghar ke door directions aur animal behavior ke superstitious signs likhe hote the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mesopotamiya mein 'omen taibalet' (Omen Tablet) ka sanbandh kisase tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Superstitious omens, architectural beliefs, and astrological portents nikalta hai. Criminal law codes, Formal royal declarations of war, Grain export customs accounts in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Superstitious omens, architectural beliefs, and astrological portents hai. Exam point: Superstitious omens, architectural beliefs, and astrological portents - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The grand royal palace of King Zimri-Lim was famously situated in which prosperous city-state?
qh: जिम्री-लिम (Zimri-Lim) का महल मेसोपोटामिया के किस शहर में स्थित था?
e: Mari ke king Zimri-Lim ka palace ancient world me architectural marvel tha jise dekhne door-door ke rulers aate the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki jimri-lim (Zimri-Lim) ka mahal mesopotamiya ke kis shahar mein sthit tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Mari hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Babylon, Akkad, Uruk in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Mari hai. Exam point: Mari - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In historical sociolinguistics, 'Division of Labour' is regarded as the defining hallmark of what?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'श्रम विभाजन' (Division of Labour) किसका मुख्य लक्षण है?
e: Division of labour urban society ka core feature hota hai jahan trade, craft, manufacture aur services ek dusre par depend karti hain. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya mein 'shram vibhajan' (Division of Labour) kisaka mukhy lakshan hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Complex urban city life hi sahi baithta hai. Nomadic pastoralism, Prehistoric hunter-gatherer bands, Isolated rural subsistence ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se Complex urban city life sahi hai. Exam point: Complex urban city life - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Beyond trade accounts, for what institutional purpose were cuneiform dictionaries and writing employed?
qh: लेखन कला के विकास के बाद मेसोपोटामिया में डिक्शनरी (शब्दकोश) का उपयोग किस लिए होता था?
o: Providing legal validity to contracts and codifying imperial laws
e: Writing ka main objective property transactions, deeds, legal decisions aur royal laws ko permanent legal validity dena tha. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki lekhan kala ke vikas ke bad mesopotamiya mein dikshanari (shabdakosh) ka upayog kis lie hota tha? Isliye antim jawab Providing legal validity to contracts and codifying... ke roop mein milta hai. Baking recipes, Board game rules, Lyrical fiction only mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Providing legal validity to contracts and codifying imperial laws sahi hai. Exam point: Providing legal validity to contracts and codifying imperial laws - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: From which regions did Mesopotamia import coveted raw minerals like lapis lazuli, copper, and timber?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग 'लापिस लाजुली' पत्थर कहाँ से मंगाते थे?
e: Mesopotamia me stones aur metals nahi the, isliye wo agriculture surplus export karke Turkey, Iran aur Gulf se minerals mangwate the. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mesopotamiya ke log 'lapis lajuli' patthar kahan se mangate the? Isi karan se Iran and Turkey (Anatolia) sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Egypt, India, China bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Iran and Turkey (Anatolia) sahi hai. Exam point: Iran and Turkey (Anatolia) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Around which historical millennium did cuneiform script and tablet writing mature in Mesopotamia?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया में 'कीलाक्षर' लिपि का विकास लगभग कब हुआ था?
e: Lagbhag 2600 BCE tak Cuneiform script aur Sumerian written language administrative records ke liye fully develop ho chuki thi. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki mesopotamiya mein 'kilakshar' lipi ka vikas lagabhag kab hua tha? Yahi wajah hai ki 2600 BCE sahi hai. 1000 BCE, 100 CE, 5000 BCE alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se 2600 BCE sahi hai. Exam point: 2600 BCE - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: In which geographical sector of Mesopotamia did urban civilization and monumental temples first emerge?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के किस क्षेत्र में सबसे पहले शहरीकरण शुरू हुआ?
e: South Mesopotamia (Sumer) ka irrigated alluvial desert basin wo jagah thi jahan first cities aur temples develop hue. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki mesopotamiya ke kis kshetr mein sabase pahale shaharikaran shuru hua? Isliye sahi nateeja Southern alluvial plain nikalta hai. Northern rain-fed foothills, Zagros mountain passes, Western Arabian desert margins is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Southern alluvial plain baithta hai. Exam point: Southern alluvial plain - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Around 2400 BCE, which Semitic language gradually superseded Sumerian as the dominant spoken tongue?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया की सभ्यता में 'अक्कादी' भाषा ने किसका स्थान लिया था?
e: 2400 BCE ke around Akkadian language ne Sumerian ko spoken language ke form me replace kar diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesopotamiya ki sabhyata mein 'akkadi' bhasha ne kisaka sthan liya tha? Isi aadhar par Sumerian chuna jaata hai. Baaki vikalp - English, Persian, Aramaic - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Sumerian hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sumerian - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What represented the cheapest and most energy-efficient mode of freight transport in ancient Mesopotamia?
qh: प्राचीन मेसोपोटामिया में परिवहन का सबसे सस्ता और आसान तरीका क्या था?
e: Nadiyo aur canals ke zariye boats se bulk goods transport karna cheapest tha kyunki isme animal feed ka cost nahi lagta tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki prachin mesopotamiya mein parivahan ka sabase sasta aur asan tarika kya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Riverine canals and natural waterways nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Human portage, Camel caravans, Solid-wheel bullock carts - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Riverine canals and natural waterways hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Riverine canals and natural waterways - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: The majestic city of Nineveh served as the imperial capital of which militaristic empire?
qh: निनवे (Nineveh) शहर किस साम्राज्य की राजधानी थी?
e: Nineveh northern Assyrian empire ki imperial capital thi jahan king Assurbanipal ne grand library establish ki thi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki ninave (Nineveh) shahar kis samrajy ki rajadhani thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Assyrian Empire sahi nikalta hai. Akkadian domain, Sumerian league, Old Babylonian Kingdom alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Assyrian Empire hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Assyrian Empire - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Based on lunar cycles, into how many months did Mesopotamian astronomers divide the calendar year?
qh: मेसोपोटामिया के लोग साल को कितने महीनों में बांटते थे?
e: Moon phases ke basis par unhone saal ko 12 lunar months aur month ko 4 weeks me standardize kiya tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mesopotamiya ke log sal ko kitane mahinon mein bantate the? Isi baat se 12 sahi sabit hota hai. 10, 6, 8 is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad 12 hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 12 - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Sargon was the legendary empire-builder and monarch of which Mesopotamian dynasty?
qh: सार्गोन (Sargon) किस समुदाय का प्रसिद्ध राजा था?
e: Sargon of Akkad ne world ka pehla territorial Akkadian empire establish kiya tha around 2334 BCE. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki sargon (Sargon) kis samuday ka prasiddh raja tha? Isi baat se Akkadian sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Assyrian, Amorite, Sumerian - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Akkadian hi hai. Exam point: Akkadian - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In biological anthropology, what does the taxonomic designation 'Homo sapiens' literally mean?
qh: मानव विकास के क्रम में 'होमो सेपियंस' (Homo Sapiens) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Latin me 'Homo' ka matlab man aur 'Sapiens' ka matlab wise ya thinking hota hai; modern humans isi category me aate hain. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki manav vikas ke kram mein 'homo sepiyans' (Homo Sapiens) shabd ka kya arth hai? In tathyon ke chalte Wise or thinking human hi sahi hai. Tool-manufacturing creature, Cave-dwelling primate, Upright walking ape alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Wise or thinking human hi hai. Exam point: Wise or thinking human - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which extinct hominin species is credited with the earliest manufacture of flaked stone tools?
qh: सबसे पहले पत्थर के औजार बनाने वाले मानव को किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Homo habilis ko 'handy man' ya tool maker kaha jata hai jinhone sabse pehle Oldowan pebble stone tools banaye. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sabase pahale patthar ke aujar banane vale manav ko kis nam se jana jata hai? Isi baat se Homo habilis sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp Homo sapiens, Homo erectus, Australopithecus bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Homo habilis hi milti hai. Exam point: Homo habilis - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which hominin species was the first to exhibit habitual bipedalism and walk fully upright?
qh: दो पैरों पर सीधे खड़े होकर चलने वाले पहले मानव को क्या कहा गया?
e: Homo erectus wo species thi jo poori tarah do pairo par sidhi khadi hokar walk aur run kar sakti thi. Is prashn ka kendra Homo erectus hai. Isliye antim jawab Homo erectus ke roop mein milta hai. Homo habilis, Hominoids, Ardipithecus ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Homo erectus hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Homo erectus - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which European country were the fossil remains of the 'Neanderthal' human first discovered in 1856?
qh: प्रसिद्ध 'निएंडरथल' (Neanderthal) मानव के अवशेष सबसे पहले किस देश में मिले थे?
e: Germany ki Neander valley me 1856 me quarry workers ko sabse pehle Neanderthal fossils mile the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki prasiddh 'niendarathal' (Neanderthal) manav ke avashesh sabase pahale kis desh mein mile the? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Germany hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp Kenya, France, Ethiopia bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Germany hai. Exam point: Germany - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which naturalist published 'On the Origin of Species' in 1859, founding the modern theory of evolution?
qh: किस वैज्ञानिक ने 'ऑन द ओरिजिन ऑफ स्पीशीज' पुस्तक लिखकर मानव विकास के सिद्धांत को स्थापित किया?
e: Charles Darwin ne 1859 me 'On the Origin of Species' publish karke natural selection ka evolutionary concept diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki kis vaijnanik ne 'on d orijin oph spishij' pustak likhakar manav vikas ke siddhant ko sthapit kiya? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Charles Darwin hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Aristotle, Isaac Newton, Jean-Baptiste Lamarck is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Charles Darwin hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Charles Darwin - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In mammalian taxonomy, what are 'Primates'?
qh: मानव विकास की कहानी में 'प्राइमेट्स' (Primates) क्या हैं?
o: A subgroup of placental mammals including prosimians, monkeys, apes, and humans
e: Primates mammals ka wo order hai jisme monkeys, apes aur humans shamil hain jinki grasping hands aur developed vision hoti hai. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki manav vikas ki kahani mein 'praimets' (Primates) kya hain? Isi baat se A subgroup of placental mammals including prosimians, monkeys, apes, and humans sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp Avian raptor family, Aquatic reptiles, Amphibian vertebrates bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan A subgroup of placental mammals including prosimians, monkeys, apes, and humans hi milti hai. Exam point: A subgroup of placental mammals including prosimians,... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where were the oldest fossil specimens of Australopithecus recovered?
qh: ऑस्ट्रेलोपिथेकस (Australopithecus) के सबसे पुराने जीवाश्म कहाँ मिले हैं?
e: Australopithecus ke oldest fossils East African Rift Valley (Olduvai Gorge, Hadar, Laetoli) se discover hue. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki ostrelopithekas (Australopithecus) ke sabase purane jivashm kahan mile hain? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par East Africa hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Western Europe, Australia, North America is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar East Africa hi hai. Exam point: East Africa - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where were the fossilized archaic remains of 'Heidelberg Man' (Homo heidelbergensis) unearthed?
qh: हाइडेल्बर्ग मानव (Heidelberg Man) के अवशेष कहाँ खोजे गए थे?
e: Homo heidelbergensis ke remains Germany ke Heidelberg (Europe) se discover hue the. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki haidelbarg manav (Heidelberg Man) ke avashesh kahan khoje gae the? Isi tathya par Europe tika hua hai. Africa, Asia, South America ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Europe baithta hai. Exam point: Europe - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The earliest archaeological evidence for the controlled use of fire is linked to which human species?
qh: आग (Fire) के नियंत्रित उपयोग के सबसे पुराने प्रमाण किस मानव प्रजाति से जुड़े हैं?
e: Homo erectus ne hearths aur controlled fire use karke warmth, protection aur food cooking seekha tha. Is prashn ka vishay Homo erectus hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Homo erectus nikalta hai. Homo habilis, Dryopithecus, Australopithecus afarensis mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Homo erectus hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Homo erectus - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the specialized anthropological discipline that studies living contemporary ethnic communities?
qh: मानव विज्ञान की वह शाखा क्या कहलाती है जो समकालीन मानव समूहों का अध्ययन करती है?
e: Ethnography modern tribal aur hunter-gatherer communities ke cultural practices aur lifestyle ki analytical study karti hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki manav vijnan ki vah shakha kya kahalati hai jo samakalin manav samuhon ka adhyayan karati hai? Isi aadhar par Ethnography chuna jaata hai. Paleoarchaeology, Morphology, Stratigraphy is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Ethnography hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Ethnography - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who are the 'Hadza' documented by modern anthropologists?
qh: हद्ज़ा (Hadza) क्या है?
o: A contemporary hunter-gatherer indigenous community in East Africa
e: Hadza Tanzania (East Africa) me Lake Eyasi ke paas rehne wala traditional hunter-gatherer group hai. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki hadja (Hadza) kya hai? Isliye antim jawab A contemporary hunter-gatherer indigenous community in East... ke roop mein milta hai. A prehistoric limestone cave, An Oldowan stone scraper, A cuneiform dialect is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab A contemporary hunter-gatherer indigenous community in East... hai. Exam point: A contemporary hunter-gatherer indigenous community in East Africa - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What does the 'Positive Feedback Mechanism' demonstrate in hominin physical evolution?
qh: पॉजिटिव फीडबैक मैकेनिज्म (Positive Feedback Mechanism) मानव विकास में क्या दर्शाता है?
o: How one evolutionary trait reinforces and accelerates another development
e: Bipedalism ne hands free kiye, free hands ne tool making badhayi, tool making ne brain develop kiya-ye chain mutual reinforcement (positive feedback) hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki pojitiv phidabaik maikenijm (Positive Feedback Mechanism) manav vikas mein kya darshata hai? Isliye antim jawab How one evolutionary trait reinforces and accelerates... ke roop mein milta hai. Hunting techniques only, Spreading of epidemic contagions, Extinction of biological phenotypes alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad How one evolutionary trait reinforces and accelerates another development hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: How one evolutionary trait reinforces and accelerates another development - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What transformative economic revolution occurred in human culture roughly 10,000 years ago?
qh: लगभग 10,000 साल पहले मानव जीवन में सबसे बड़ा बदलाव क्या आया?
o: Adoption of Agriculture, Plant Cultivation, and Animal Domestication
e: Neolithic Revolution me humans ne hunting-gathering chhodkar agriculture aur livestock domestication shuru kiya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki lagabhag 10,000 sal pahale manav jivan mein sabase bada badalav kya aya? Isliye sahi nateeja Adoption of Agriculture, Plant Cultivation, and Animal Domestication nikalta hai. Mastery of basic spark fire, Abandonment of vocal language, Return to pure troglodytic foraging anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Adoption of Agriculture, Plant Cultivation, and Animal... hai. Exam point: Adoption of Agriculture, Plant Cultivation, and Animal... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Where is the famous Paleolithic cave site of 'Altamira', renowned for polychrome animal murals, located?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव के गुफा चित्रों के प्रसिद्ध उदाहरण 'अल्तमिरा' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Altamira caves northern Spain me hain jahan prehistoric Upper Paleolithic bison paintings milti hain. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki praranbhik manav ke gupha chitron ke prasiddh udaharan 'altamira' kahan sthit hai? Isi baat se Spain sahi sabit hota hai. South Africa, India, France alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Spain hai. Exam point: Spain - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the archaeological designation 'Proto-history' refer to?
qh: मानव विकास के क्रम में 'प्रोटो-हिस्ट्री' (Proto-history) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Period for which written records exist but remain undeciphered
e: Proto-history wo period hai jiske written records exist karte hain par abhi tak decipher nahi ho sake hain (jaise Harappan script). Prashn yah batata hai ki manav vikas ke kram mein 'proto-histri' (Proto-history) se kya tatpary hai? Isi karan se Period for which written records exist but... sahi uttar hai. Era without any written records, Fully documented modern history, Acheulean stone age mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Period for which written records exist but remain undeciphered hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Period for which written records exist but... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the specialized 'Punch Blade Technique' used for in the Upper Paleolithic?
qh: पंच ब्लेड तकनीक (Punch Blade Technique) का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता था?
o: Detaching thin, razor-sharp parallel-sided stone blades from a prepared core
e: Punch blade technique me bone/antler punch use karke stone core se thin, sharp blade tools nikale jaate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki panch bled takanik (Punch Blade Technique) ka upayog kis lie kiya jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Detaching thin, razor-sharp parallel-sided stone blades from a prepared core sahi hai. Vikalp Animal penning, Engraving wall murals, Roasting animal marrow bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Detaching thin, razor-sharp parallel-sided stone blades from a prepared core hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Detaching thin, razor-sharp parallel-sided stone blades from... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What primary morphological distinctions separate Hominids from Hominoids?
qh: होमिनिड्स (Hominids) और होमिनॉयड्स (Hominoids) में मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Hominids possess larger brains, upright posture, and bipedal locomotion
e: Hominids bipedal hote hain, sidhe khade ho sakte hain aur unka brain size hominoids (apes) se significantly bada hota hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki hominids (Hominids) aur hominoyads (Hominoids) mein mukhy antar kya hai? Isi baat se Hominids possess larger brains, upright posture, and bipedal locomotion sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Hominoids have prehensile tails, Hominids possess smaller cranial capacities, Zero biological difference - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Hominids possess larger brains, upright posture, and bipedal locomotion hai. Exam point: Hominids possess larger brains, upright posture, and bipedal locomotion - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the initial primary incentive for early humans to domesticate animals?
qh: मानव द्वारा जानवरों को पालतू बनाने का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: Reliable on-demand food supply (meat, milk) and security
e: Hunting par dependency kam karne ke liye milk, meat aur guard support ke purpose se animals domesticate kiye gaye. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki manav dvara janavaron ko palatu banane ka prathamik uddeshy kya tha? Isi aadhar par Reliable on-demand food supply (meat, milk) and security chuna jaata hai. Vikalp Trading luxury goods, Religious idol carving, Aesthetic recreation bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Reliable on-demand food supply (meat, milk) and security hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Reliable on-demand food supply (meat, milk) and... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: At which archaeological site in Southern France were the post-hole remains of seasonal huts excavated at 'Terra Amata'?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव के रहने के स्थान 'टेरा अमाटा' (Terra Amata) के अवशेष कहाँ मिले हैं?
e: Terra Amata Nice (France) me beachside site hai jahan early hominins ke banaye temporary wooden huts ke evidence mile. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki praranbhik manav ke rahane ke sthan 'tera amata' (Terra Amata) ke avashesh kahan mile hain? Isliye sahi nateeja France nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - India, Kenya, Germany - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se France sahi hai. Exam point: France - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: According to evolutionary linguistics, what was the earliest operational form of hominin communication?
qh: मानव विकास की कहानी के अनुसार सबसे पहले भाषा का रूप क्या रहा होगा?
o: Gestures, body language, and non-verbal hand signals
e: Spoken words aane se pehle hominins visual body gestures, hand movements aur non-verbal grunts se communicate karte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki manav vikas ki kahani ke anusar sabase pahale bhasha ka rup kya raha hoga? Yahi wajah hai ki Gestures, body language, and non-verbal hand signals sahi hai. Formal written syntax, Complex musical singing, Grammatical spoken dialect is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Gestures, body language, and non-verbal hand signals hai. Exam point: Gestures, body language, and non-verbal hand signals - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How is a 'Fossil' scientifically defined in paleontology?
qh: फॉसिल (Fossil) क्या है?
o: The petrified remains or mineralized impressions of ancient organic life preserved in rock
e: Millions of years purane plants, animals ya human bones jo sedimentary rock strata me mineralize hokar stone ban jaate hain, Fossils kehlaate hain. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki phosil (Fossil) kya hai? Isi karan se The petrified remains or mineralized impressions of ancient organic life preserved in rock sahi uttar hai. Volcanic sediment, An unweathered flint core, A freshly germinated sapling in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad The petrified remains or mineralized impressions of... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: The petrified remains or mineralized impressions of ancient organic life preserved in rock - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which continent is scientifically identified as the geographical cradle and origin point of Homo sapiens?
qh: होमो सेपियंस का मूल उत्पत्ति स्थान किसे माना जाता है?
e: Genetic aur fossil evidence confirm karte hain ki modern Homo sapiens lagbhag 300,000 saal pehle Africa me evolve hue aur wahan se migrate hue. Prashn yah batata hai ki homo sepiyans ka mul utpatti sthan kise mana jata hai? Isliye antim jawab Africa ke roop mein milta hai. Asia, Europe, Australia alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Africa hi milti hai. Exam point: Africa - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did early hominin 'Scavenging' behavior entail?
qh: प्रारंभिक मानव का 'स्कैवेंजिंग' (Scavenging) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Foraging meat and bone marrow from carcasses left by apex carnivores or natural death
e: Early hominins predators ke maare hue ya naturally dead janwaron ke carcasses se bacha hua meat aur bone marrow gather karte the. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki praranbhik manav ka 'skaiveinjing' (Scavenging) se kya tatpary hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Foraging meat and bone marrow from carcasses left by apex carnivores or natural death hi sahi baithta hai. Cave interior painting, Mud hut plastering, Cultivating wild grains is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Foraging meat and bone marrow from carcasses left by apex carnivores or natural death baithta hai. Exam point: Foraging meat and bone marrow from carcasses... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What does Charles Darwin's concept of 'Natural Selection' posit regarding evolutionary adaptation?
qh: डार्विन के अनुसार मानव विकास में 'नेचुरल सिलेक्शन' (Natural Selection) क्या है?
o: Differential survival and reproductive success of organisms best adapted to their ecological niche
e: Environmental changes me wahi organisms survive aur reproduce karte hain jinki genetic traits environment ke anukul hoti hain (Survival of the fittest). Prashn ka saar yah hai ki darvin ke anusar manav vikas mein 'nechural silekshan' (Natural Selection) kya hai? Isi tathya par Differential survival and reproductive success of organisms... tika hua hai. Random artificial breeding by humans, Catastrophic instantaneous biological mutation, Animal domestication methods is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Differential survival and reproductive success of organisms best adapted to their ecological niche hi hai. Exam point: Differential survival and reproductive success of organisms... - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which monumental societal transformation materialized across river valleys roughly 5,000 years ago?
qh: लगभग 5,000 साल पहले मानव समाज में कौन सा बड़ा विकास हुआ?
o: Emergence of urban centers, statecraft, and pristine civilizations
e: Farming surplus ke baad 5000 saal pehle Bronze Age cities, centralized empires aur organized state systems (Mesopotamia, Harappa) emerge hue. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki lagabhag 5,000 sal pahale manav samaj mein kaun sa bada vikas hua? Isliye sahi nateeja Emergence of urban centers, statecraft, and pristine civilizations nikalta hai. Extinction of stone implements, Potter's wheel invention, Controlled friction fire alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Emergence of urban centers, statecraft, and pristine... hai. Exam point: Emergence of urban centers, statecraft, and pristine civilizations - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the measured architectural height of the rustless Iron Pillar standing at Mehrauli, Delhi?
qh: दिल्ली के महरौली में स्थित लौह स्तंभ (Iron Pillar) की ऊंचाई कितनी है?
e: Mehrauli ka Iron Pillar lagbhag 7.2 meters uncha hai aur iska weight around 3 tonnes se zyada hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki dilli ke maharauli mein sthit lauh stanbh (Iron Pillar) ki unchai kitani hai? Isliye sahi nateeja 7.2 meters nikalta hai. 5.2 meters, 8.5 meters, 10.0 meters is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 7.2 meters hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 7.2 meters - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which ruler's name is inscribed in Brahmi script on the Mehrauli Iron Pillar?
qh: महरौली लौह स्तंभ पर खुदे हुए इनस्क्रिप्शन में किस राजा का नाम मिलता है?
e: Pillar par 'Chandra' naam ke ruler ka mention hai, jise historians Gupta Emperor Chandragupta II Vikramaditya identify karte hain. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki maharauli lauh stanbh par khude hue inaskripshan mein kis raja ka nam milata hai? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Chandra nikalta hai. Baaki vikalp - Ashoka, Samudragupta, Kanishka - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Chandra hi milti hai. Exam point: Chandra - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the literal Sanskrit translation and meaning of the Buddhist word 'Stupa'?
qh: स्तूप (Stupa) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या होता है?
e: Sanskrit me Stupa ka literal meaning 'Mound' yaani dher/teela hota hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki stup (Stupa) shabd ka shabdik arth kya hota hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Mound sahi nikalta hai. Galti Palace, Cave, Hill chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Mound hai. Exam point: Mound - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the small container embedded at the core of a Stupa containing sacred bodily relics called?
qh: स्तूप के भीतर रखे गए उस छोटे डिब्बे को क्या कहते हैं जिसमें बुद्ध या उनके अनुयायियों के अवशेष रखे जाते थे?
e: Stupa ke center me 'Relic Casket' (Dhatu Manjusha) rakha jata tha jisme teeth, bone ya ash rakhi jaati thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki stup ke bhitar rakhe gae us chhote dibbe ko kya kahate hain jisamein buddh ya unake anuyayiyon ke avashesh rakhe jate the? stupa Buddha ke avsheshon par bana dher jaisa smarak hota tha. Isi baat se Relic Casket (Dhatu Manjusha) sahi sabit hota hai. Garbhagriha, Mandapa, Shikhara in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Relic Casket (Dhatu Manjusha) baithta hai. Exam point: Relic Casket (Dhatu Manjusha) - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the circular ambulatory corridor laid around a Stupa for devotional circumambulation called?
qh: स्तूप के चारों ओर परिक्रमा करने के लिए बनाए गए वृत्ताकार पथ को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Stupa ke chaaro taraf clockwise circumambulation ke liye bane path ko Pradakshina Patha kehte hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki stup ke charon or parikrama karane ke lie banae gae vrittakar path ko kya kaha jata hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Pradakshina Patha hi sahi baithta hai. Antarala, Mandapa, Shikhara is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Pradakshina Patha hai. Exam point: Pradakshina Patha - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What is the inner sanctuary of an ancient Hindu temple housing the principal deity called?
qh: मंदिर के उस मुख्य भाग को क्या कहते हैं जहाँ मुख्य देवी या देवता की मूर्ति रखी जाती थी?
e: Garbhagriha temple ka central sanctum sanctorum hota hai jahan main deity ki murti install hoti hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mandir ke us mukhy bhag ko kya kahate hain jahan mukhy devi ya devata ki murti rakhi jati thi? jati ek hi samaj ke andar chhote-chhote samooh the. Isi karan se Garbhagriha sahi uttar hai. Mandapa, Gopuram, Shikhara anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Garbhagriha sahi hai. Exam point: Garbhagriha - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: The ancient Gupta-era brick temple at Bhitargaon (Uttar Pradesh) was constructed using which material?
qh: उत्तर प्रदेश के भीतरगाँव का मंदिर लगभग 1500 साल पहले किस सामग्री से बनाया गया था?
e: Bhitargaon ka temple ancient India ke sabse purane surviving brick temples me se ek hai jo baked bricks se bana hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki uttar pradesh ke bhitaraganv ka mandir lagabhag 1500 sal pahale kis samagri se banaya gaya tha? Isi tathya par Baked bricks and stone mortar tika hua hai. Chiseled marble only, Teakwood framing, Cast iron slabs is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Baked bricks and stone mortar baithta hai. Exam point: Baked bricks and stone mortar - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What is the standout architectural characteristic of the Pallava rock temples at Mahabalipuram?
qh: महाबलीपुरम के मंदिरों की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: Monolithic structures carved out of singular granite boulders
e: Mahabalipuram ke rath temples Monolithic hain, yaani ek hi gigantic granite rock ko cut karke pure temple banaye gaye hain. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki mahabalipuram ke mandiron ki mukhy visheshata kya hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Monolithic structures carved out of singular granite boulders hi sahi baithta hai. Built with baked kiln bricks, Erected on high alluvial riverbeds, Framed with timber trusses in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Monolithic structures carved out of singular granite boulders hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Monolithic structures carved out of singular granite boulders - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Under what artificial illumination were the intricate mural frescoes inside the dark Ajanta caves executed?
qh: अजंता की गुफाओं में चित्रकारी मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकाश में की गई थी?
e: Ajanta caves ke andar natural daylight nahi thi, isliye artists ne torches aur brass reflectors ki light me paintings draw ki thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki ajanta ki guphaon mein chitrakari mukhy rup se kis prakash mein ki gai thi? Isi karan se Torchlight and brass reflector light sahi uttar hai. Galti Direct sunlight mirrors, Electric dynamo bulbs, Moonlight reflections chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Torchlight and brass reflector light hi milti hai. Exam point: Torchlight and brass reflector light - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who composed the celebrated classic Tamil Sangam epic 'Silappadikaram'?
qh: तमिल महाकाव्य 'शिलप्पदिकारम' (Silappadikaram) की रचना किसने की थी?
e: Silappadikaram ki rachna Ilango Adigal ne lagbhag 1800 saal pehle ki thi. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki tamil mahakavy 'shilappadikaram' (Silappadikaram) ki rachana kisane ki thi? In tathyon ke chalte Ilango Adigal hi sahi hai. Sattanar, Kalidasa, Thiruvalluvar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Ilango Adigal hi hai. Exam point: Ilango Adigal - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: The epic 'Silappadikaram' narrates the tragic saga of which merchant and his chaste wife Kannagi?
qh: शिलप्पदिकारम महाकाव्य किस व्यापारी और उसकी पत्नी कण्णगी की कहानी है?
e: Ye Puhar ke merchant Kovalan aur uski loyal wife Kannagi ke anklet ki tragic love story hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki shilappadikaram mahakavy kis vyapari aur usaki patni kannagi ki kahani hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Kovalan nikalta hai. Galti Nedunjeral, Madhavi, Neduncheliyan chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Kovalan hi hai. Exam point: Kovalan - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who authored the famous sequel Tamil epic 'Manimekalai'?
qh: दूसरा प्रसिद्ध तमिल महाकाव्य 'मणिमेखलाई' (Manimekalai) किसके द्वारा लिखा गया था?
e: Manimekalai ko poet Chithalai Sathanar (Sattanar) ne likha tha, jo Kovalan aur Madhavi ki beti Manimekalai par based hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dusara prasiddh tamil mahakavy 'manimekhalai' (Manimekalai) kisake dvara likha gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Sattanar hi sahi baithta hai. Ilango Adigal, Valmiki, Vyasa is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Sattanar hai. Exam point: Sattanar - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which classical language did Mahakavi Kalidasa compose his literary masterpieces?
qh: कालिदास ने अपनी प्रसिद्ध रचनाएं किस भाषा में लिखी थीं?
e: Kalidasa Gupta period ke court poet the aur unke saare plays aur poems classical Sanskrit me composed hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kalidas ne apani prasiddh rachanaen kis bhasha mein likhi thin? Isi karan se Sanskrit sahi uttar hai. Galti Prakrit, Pali, Tamil chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Sanskrit baithta hai. Exam point: Sanskrit - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the overarching cultural objective behind compiling the Hindu Puranas?
qh: पुराणों (Puranas) का संकलन मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य के लिए किया गया था?
o: Restricting spiritual knowledge solely to kings
Preserving and disseminating devotional narratives of deities accessible to all
e: Puranas easy Sanskrit me compile kiye gaye the taaki women aur shudras samet sabhi log devi-devtaon ki stories sun sakein. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki puranon (Puranas) ka sankalan mukhy rup se kis uddeshy ke lie kiya gaya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Preserving and disseminating devotional narratives of deities accessible to all hi sahi baithta hai. Restricting spiritual knowledge solely to kings, Documenting military weapon tactics, Codifying maritime commercial tariffs ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Preserving and disseminating devotional narratives of deities accessible to all hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Preserving and disseminating devotional narratives of deities accessible to all - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which legendary sage is traditionally credited with the compilation of both the Mahabharata and the Puranas?
qh: महाभारत और पुराणों दोनों का संकलन किसने किया था?
e: Tradition ke hisaab se sage Veda Vyasa ne Mahabharata aur Puranas ko compile kiya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mahabharat aur puranon donon ka sankalan kisane kiya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Vyasa (Veda Vyasa) nikalta hai. Chanakya, Valmiki, Tulsidas is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Vyasa (Veda Vyasa) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Vyasa (Veda Vyasa) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who is revered as the original composer of the epic Ramayana in classical Sanskrit?
qh: संस्कृत रामायण के रचयिता कौन माने जाते हैं?
e: Maharshi Valmiki ko original classical Sanskrit Ramayana ka author maana jata hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki sanskrit ramayan ke rachayita kaun mane jate hain? Yahi wajah hai ki Valmiki sahi hai. Galti Kalidasa, Tulsidas, Vyasa chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Valmiki hi milti hai. Exam point: Valmiki - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which folklore collections were the moral tales narrated by ordinary people preserved?
qh: आम लोगों द्वारा कही जाने वाली कहानियों का संग्रह किन पुस्तकों में मिलता है?
e: Aam janta ki moral stories aur animal fables ko Buddhist Jatakas aur Vishnu Sharma ke Panchatantra me preserve kiya gaya. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki am logon dvara kahi jane vali kahaniyon ka sangrah kin pustakon mein milata hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Jatakas and Panchatantra nikalta hai. Brahmanas, Rigvedic Samhitas, Dharma Sutras anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Jatakas and Panchatantra hi hai. Exam point: Jatakas and Panchatantra - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which pathbreaking astronomical treatise in Sanskrit was authored by Aryabhata?
qh: गणितज्ञ और खगोलशास्त्री आर्यभट्ट ने कौन सी पुस्तक लिखी थी?
e: Gupta era ke genius Aryabhata ne astronomy aur mathematics par 'Aryabhatiyam' treatise likhi thi. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki ganitajn aur khagolashastri aryabhatt ne kaun si pustak likhi thi? Isi aadhar par Aryabhatiyam chuna jaata hai. Charaka Samhita, Meghadutam, Surya Siddhanta mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Aryabhatiyam baithta hai. Exam point: Aryabhatiyam - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What scientific explanation did Aryabhata propose for the daily cycle of day and night?
qh: आर्यभट्ट ने दिन और रात होने का क्या कारण बताया था?
o: The axial rotation of the Earth on its own axis
The shadow cast by the moon
The physical orbit of the Sun around the Earth
e: Aryabhata ne explain kiya tha ki Sun stationary dikhta hai aur day-night Earth ke apne axis par rotate hone se hote hain. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki aryabhatt ne din aur rat hone ka kya karan bataya tha? Isliye sahi nateeja The axial rotation of the Earth on its own axis nikalta hai. The shadow cast by the moon, Atmospheric dust movement, The physical orbit of the Sun around the Earth anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar The axial rotation of the Earth on its own axis hi hai. Exam point: The axial rotation of the Earth on its own axis - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Who authored the foundational ancient Indian medical compendium 'Charaka Samhita'?
qh: प्राचीन भारत में चिकित्सा (Medicine) पर लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'चरक संहिता' के लेखक कौन हैं?
e: Maharshi Charaka Ayurveda ke master the jinhone internal medicine par 'Charaka Samhita' likhi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki prachin bharat mein chikitsa (Medicine) par likhi gai prasiddh pustak 'charak sanhita' ke lekhak kaun hain? Isi aadhar par Charaka chuna jaata hai. Bhaskara I, Brahmagupta, Sushruta is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Charaka hai. Exam point: Charaka - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who authored the 'Sushruta Samhita', celebrated for its descriptions of surgical instruments and procedures?
qh: शल्य चिकित्सा (Surgery) के विस्तृत विवरण वाली 'सुश्रुत संहिता' किसने लिखी थी?
e: Sushruta ko Father of Surgery kaha jata hai jinhone rhinoplasty aur cataract surgery ka details 'Sushruta Samhita' me diya. Prashn yah batata hai ki shaly chikitsa (Surgery) ke vistrit vivaran vali 'sushrut sanhita' kisane likhi thi? Isi baat se Sushruta sahi sabit hota hai. Charaka, Varahamihira, Aryabhata is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav Sushruta hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Sushruta - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Scholars of which country invented the standalone positional numeral symbol for Zero?
qh: शून्य (Zero) के लिए विशेष चिह्न का आविष्कार किस देश के गणितज्ञों ने किया था?
e: India ke mathematicians ne zero ko as a separate number aur special symbol invent karke place-value system ko complete kiya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki shuny (Zero) ke lie vishesh chihn ka avishkar kis desh ke ganitajnon ne kiya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par India hi sahi baithta hai. China, Greece, Egypt alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad India hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: India - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which trading civilization adopted the Indian decimal-numeral system and introduced it to medieval Europe?
qh: भारतीय गणना पद्धति (Counting system) को अपनाकर इसे यूरोप तक किसने फैलाया?
e: Arabs ne Indian mathematical numerals aur zero ko adopt kiya jahan se ye Europe me 'Hindu-Arabic numerals' ban kar phaila. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki bharatiy ganana paddhati (Counting system) ko apanakar ise yurop tak kisane phailaya? Isliye sahi nateeja Arab scholars and merchants nikalta hai. Chinese sailors, British merchants, Venetian traders in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Arab scholars and merchants hi hai. Exam point: Arab scholars and merchants - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the purpose of a 'Mandapa' in classical temple architecture?
qh: मंदिरों में 'मंडप' (Mandapa) का क्या उपयोग होता था?
o: A congregational pillared hall where devotees could assemble
e: Mandapa temple ka wo pillared hall ya portico hota tha jahan devotees religious discourses aur rituals ke liye assemble hote the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki mandiron mein 'mandap' (Mandapa) ka kya upayog hota tha? Isi baat se A congregational pillared hall where devotees could assemble sahi sabit hota hai. Kitchen warehouse, Circumambulatory roof, Housing the main deity mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se A congregational pillared hall where devotees could assemble sahi hai. Exam point: A congregational pillared hall where devotees could assemble - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which lyrical poem of Kalidasa does an exiled lover send a message to his beloved via a cloud?
qh: कालिदास की प्रसिद्ध कविता जिसमें विरही प्रेमी के संदेश का वर्णन है, उसका नाम क्या है?
e: Meghaduta me ek Yaksha cloud ko messenger banakar Alakapuri me apni beloved ko message bhejta hai. Prashn yah batata hai ki kalidas ki prasiddh kavita jisamein virahi premi ke sandesh ka varnan hai, usaka nam kya hai? Isliye antim jawab Meghaduta ke roop mein milta hai. Raghuvamsha, Kumarasambhava, Abhigyana Shakuntalam is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Meghaduta hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Meghaduta - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What were sea cowries (Kaudis) predominantly utilized as in ancient Afro-Eurasian trade?
qh: प्राचीन काल में कौड़ियों (Cowries) का उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता था?
e: Maldives se aane wali cowrie shells ancient time me international trade me reliable currency ki tarah use hoti thi. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki prachin kal mein kaudaiyon (Cowries) ka upayog kis rup mein kiya jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Currency / Medium of exchange hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Galti Metal weaponry, Ceramic pottery glazes, Stone carving chisels chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Currency / Medium of exchange sahi hai. Exam point: Currency / Medium of exchange - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which vast trans-continental land and maritime networks were interconnected by the historical Silk Route?
qh: सिल्क रूट (Silk Route) मुख्य रूप से किन क्षेत्रों को जोड़ता था?
e: Silk route Asia ke commercial hubs ko Europe aur North Africa se jodne wala overland aur maritime network tha. Yah prashn Asia, Europe, and Northern Africa se juda hai. Isi karan se Asia, Europe, and Northern Africa sahi uttar hai. The Americas and Sub-Saharan Africa, Polynesia and Australia, Greenland and Europe mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Asia, Europe, and Northern Africa hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Asia, Europe, and Northern Africa - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Who authored the Marathi travelogue 'Majha Pravas', documenting eyewitness accounts of the 1857 revolt?
qh: विष्णु भट्ट गोडसे द्वारा लिखित पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
o: Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
e: Vishnu Bhatt Godse ne 'Majha Pravas' likhi thi jisme 1857 revolt ke dauran Jhansi aur North India ke eyewitness accounts hain. Prashn yah batata hai ki vishnu bhatt godase dvara likhit pustak ka nam kya hai? Isi karan se Majha Pravas sahi uttar hai. Anandamath, Satyarth Prakash, Poverty and Un-British Rule in India ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Majha Pravas hai. Exam point: Majha Pravas - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What technological marvel of the Mehrauli Iron Pillar continues to perplex modern metallurgists?
qh: दिल्ली के महरौली में स्थित 'लौह स्तंभ' (Iron Pillar) की सबसे बड़ी विशेषता क्या है, जो वैज्ञानिकों को आज भी आश्चर्यचकित करती है?
o: Complete absence of rust and corrosion after 1500 years of open-air exposure
e: 1500 saal se open sky me khada rehne ke baad bhi Mehrauli Iron Pillar par passive rust layer (misawite) ki wajah se jung nahi laga. Yah prashn Complete absence of rust and corrosion after 1500 years of open-air exposure se juda hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Complete absence of rust and corrosion after 1500 years of open-air exposure nikalta hai. Absence of weight, Hollow core, Its gold casting in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Complete absence of rust and corrosion after 1500 years of open-air exposure hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Complete absence of rust and corrosion after... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The monumental superstructure erected vertically over the Garbhagriha to signify its sanctity is termed:
qh: गर्भ गृह के ऊपर काफी ऊँचाई तक बनाए जाने वाले ढांचे को क्या कहते हैं?
e: North Indian temple architecture me Garbhagriha ke theek upar banaye gaye tall tapering tower ko Shikhara kehte hain. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki garbh grih ke upar kaphi unchai tak banae jane vale dhanche ko kya kahate hain? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Shikhara hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Stupa, Mandapa, Torana anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Shikhara hi milti hai. Exam point: Shikhara - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What important epigraphic pillar inscription composed by court poet Harishena records the conquests of Samudragupta?
qh: प्रसिद्ध गुप्त शासक समुद्रगुप्त के बारे में जानकारी किस महत्वपूर्ण शिलालेख से मिलती है?
e: Allahabad Ashokan pillar par Harishena dwara sanskrit me likhi Prayag Prashasti se Samudragupta ki victories ka pata chalta hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki prasiddh gupt shasak samudragupt ke bare mein janakari kis mahatvapurn shilalekh se milati hai? Isi baat se Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription) sahi sabit hota hai. Hathigumpha Inscription, Junagadh Rock Inscription, Mehrauli Pillar Inscription ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription) baithta hai. Exam point: Prayag Prashasti (Allahabad Pillar Inscription) - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who was the royal court poet and minister who composed the Sanskrit eulogy known as the Prayag Prashasti?
qh: समुद्रगुप्त के दरबारी कवि और मंत्री कौन थे, जिन्होंने प्रयाग प्रशस्ति की रचना की थी?
e: Harishena Samudragupta ke Mahadandanayaka aur court poet the jinhone chaste Sanskrit me Prayag Prashasti compose ki. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki samudragupt ke darabari kavi aur mantri kaun the, jinhonne prayag prashasti ki rachana ki thi? In tathyon ke chalte Harishena hi sahi hai. Vikalp Kalidasa, Banabhatta, Ravikirti bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Harishena hai. Exam point: Harishena - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: According to the Prayag Prashasti, how many rulers of Aryavarta did Samudragupta uproot and annex?
qh: प्रयाग प्रशस्ति के अनुसार, समुद्रगुप्त ने आर्यावर्त के कुल कितने शासकों को हराकर उनके राज्यों को अपने साम्राज्य में मिला लिया था?
e: Samudragupta ne Aryavarta (Northern India) ke 9 kings ko defeat karke unke kingdoms ko directly Gupta empire me merge kiya. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki prayag prashasti ke anusar, samudragupt ne aryavart ke kul kitane shasakon ko harakar unake rajyon ko apane samrajy mein mila liya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 9 sahi nikalta hai. 5, 12, 15 is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 9 hi hai. Exam point: 9 - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: How many southern rulers of Dakshinapatha surrendered to Samudragupta and were reinstated as tributary vassals?
qh: दक्षिणपंथ के कितने शासकों ने हारने के बाद समुद्रगुप्त के सामने आत्मसमर्पण किया और बाद में उन्हें फिर से शासन करने की अनुमति दी गई?
e: Samudragupta ne Dakshinapatha ke 12 rulers ko capture karke chhod diya (Grahana-Mokshanugraha policy) aur tributary banaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dakshinapanth ke kitane shasakon ne harane ke bad samudragupt ke samane atmasamarpan kiya aur bad mein unhein phir se shasan karane ki anumati di gai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par 12 hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. 20, 9, 18 mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar 12 hai. Exam point: 12 - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the first imperial Gupta monarch to assume the grandiose sovereign title of 'Maharajadhiraja'?
qh: गुप्त वंश के किस शासक ने सबसे पहले 'महाराजाधिराज' जैसी बड़ी उपाधि धारण की थी?
e: Chandragupta I pehle Gupta ruler the jinhone Lichchhavi princess Kumaradevi se marriage ke baad 'Maharajadhiraja' title adopt kiya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki gupt vansh ke kis shasak ne sabase pahale 'maharajadhiraj' jaisi badai upadhi dharan ki thi? Chandragupta Maurya vansh ka sansthapak tha jisne Magadh se badi satta khadi ki. Isi karan se Chandragupta I sahi uttar hai. Sri Gupta, Ghatotkacha, Samudragupta is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Chandragupta I hi milti hai. Exam point: Chandragupta I - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: To which ancient clan or Gana did Kumaradevi, the royal mother of Emperor Samudragupta, belong?
qh: समुद्रगुप्त की माँ, कुमारदेवी, किस गण या वंश से संबंधित थीं?
e: Kumaradevi prestigious Licchavi clan ki princess thi, isliye Samudragupta ko coins par 'Licchavi-dauhitra' likha gaya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki samudragupt ki man, kumaradevi, kis gan ya vansh se sanbandhit thin? gana ek samooh shasan wali vyavastha thi jismein sabhi sadasya milkar faisle karte the. Isi aadhar par Licchavi Gana chuna jaata hai. Kuru clan, Malla Gana, Shakya Gana in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Licchavi Gana hai. Exam point: Licchavi Gana - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which musical instrument is Emperor Samudragupta depicted playing on his gold numismatic issues?
qh: सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए किस गुप्त राजा को दिखाया गया है?
e: Samudragupta ke gold coins par unhe couch par baithkar Veena play karte hue dikhaya gaya hai, jo unka music talent darshata hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki sikkon par vina bajate hue kis gupt raja ko dikhaya gaya hai? Chandragupta Maurya vansh ka sansthapak tha jisne Magadh se badi satta khadi ki. Isi tathya par Samudragupta tika hua hai. Kumaragupta, Skandagupta, Chandragupta II in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Samudragupta hi hai. Exam point: Samudragupta - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Gupta ruler adopted the imperial title 'Vikramaditya' after defeating the Western Kshatrapa Shakas?
qh: शकों पर विजय के प्रतीक के रूप में 'विक्रमादित्य' की उपाधि किसने धारण की थी?
e: Chandragupta II ne Western India se Shaka rulers ko eradicate karke 'Vikramaditya' aur 'Sakari' title liya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki shakon par vijay ke pratik ke rup mein 'vikramadity' ki upadhi kisane dharan ki thi? Chandragupta Maurya vansh ka sansthapak tha jisne Magadh se badi satta khadi ki. In tathyon ke chalte Chandragupta II hi sahi hai. Vikalp Samudragupta, Harshavardhana, Chandragupta I bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Chandragupta II baithta hai. Exam point: Chandragupta II - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who was the court poet who authored the biography 'Harshacharita' praising King Harshavardhana?
qh: हर्षवर्धन के दरबारी कवि कौन थे, जिन्होंने उनकी जीवनी 'हर्षचरित' लिखी थी?
e: Banabhatta ne Sanskrit me Harshavardhana ki early life aur deeds par 'Harshacharita' likhi thi.
