Prashn is baat par tika hai ki harshavardhan ke darabari kavi kaun the, jinhonne unaki jivani 'harshacharit' likhi thi? Isi karan se Banabhatta sahi uttar hai. Harishena, Bhasa, Ravikirti mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Banabhatta hi milti hai. Exam point: Banabhatta - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Chalukya sovereign checked the southward imperial expansion of Harshavardhana on the banks of the Narmada?
qh: हर्षवर्धन को दक्षिण की ओर बढ़ने से किस चालुक्य राजा ने नर्मदा नदी के तट पर रोका था?
e: Chalukya king Pulakeshin II ne Narmada nadi ke kinare Harshavardhana ko defeat karke unka south expansion halt kar diya. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki harshavardhan ko dakshin ki or badhane se kis chaluky raja ne narmada nadi ke tat par roka tha? In tathyon ke chalte Pulakeshin II hi sahi hai. Pulakeshin I, Narasimhavarman I, Vikramaditya I alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Pulakeshin II hi hai. Exam point: Pulakeshin II - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Who composed the celebrated Aihole stone Prashasti detailing the military feats of Chalukya King Pulakeshin II?
qh: पुलकेशिन द्वितीय के बारे में जानकारी उनके दरबारी कवि द्वारा रचित प्रशस्ति से मिलती है, उनका नाम क्या था?
e: Jain poet Ravikirti ne Aihole inscription compose kiya tha jisme Pulakeshin II ki Harsha par victory ka description hai. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki pulakeshin dvitiy ke bare mein janakari unake darabari kavi dvara rachit prashasti se milati hai, unaka nam kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Ravikirti hi sahi baithta hai. Harishena, Banabhatta, Dandin in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Ravikirti hi hai. Exam point: Ravikirti - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the capital of the Pallava dynasty situated near the fertile Kaveri delta?
qh: पल्लव राजाओं की राजधानी कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Pallavas ki capital Kanchipuram thi, jo religious aur temple architecture ka bohot bada center bani. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki pallav rajaon ki rajadhani kahan sthit thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Kanchipuram nikalta hai. Galti Madurai, Pataliputra, Aihole chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Kanchipuram hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Kanchipuram - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which vibrant commercial trading center and temple town served as an early capital of the Chalukyas?
qh: चालुक्यों का मुख्य व्यापारिक और सांस्कृतिक केंद्र कौन सा था, जो उनकी राजधानी भी थी?
e: Aihole Chalukyas ka early commercial trading hub aur temple architecture ka lab tha jise baad me Badami move kiya gaya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki chalukyon ka mukhy vyaparik aur sanskritik keindr kaun sa tha, jo unaki rajadhani bhi thi? Isi tathya par Aihole tika hua hai. Kanchipuram, Vengi, Badami in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Aihole hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Aihole - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In the administrative hierarchy of the Gupta Empire, what was the portfolio of a 'Mahadandanayaka'?
qh: गुप्त काल में 'महादंडनायक' पद का क्या अर्थ था?
e: Mahadandanayaka ka post Chief Judicial Officer aur high-ranking judicial-military authority ka hota tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki gupt kal mein 'mahadandanayak' pad ka kya arth tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Chief Judicial Officer / Army Commander hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Village registrar, Treasurer general, Tax collector is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Chief Judicial Officer / Army Commander hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Chief Judicial Officer / Army Commander - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the high-ranking administrative title 'Kumara-amatya' signify during the Gupta era?
qh: गुप्त और उत्तर-गुप्त काल में 'कुमार-अमात्य' का पद किसे दिया जाता था?
e: Kumara-amatya central administration me high executive officer aur versatile minister rank hoti thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gupt aur uttar-gupt kal mein 'kumar-amaty' ka pad kise diya jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki High-ranking Minister / High executive official sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Customs collector, Foreign emissary, Royal scribe - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab High-ranking Minister / High executive official hai. Exam point: High-ranking Minister / High executive official - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: In the administrative terminology of southern kingdoms, what was a 'Sabha'?
qh: दक्षिण के राज्यों में 'सभा' किसे कहा जाता था?
e: Pallava records me Sabha un villages ki assembly hoti thi jahan land Brahmin proprietors (Brahmadeya) ke paas thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki dakshin ke rajyon mein 'sabha' kise kaha jata tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi karan se Assembly of Brahmin landowning proprietors sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Village folk court, Mercenary guild, Artisan council - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Assembly of Brahmin landowning proprietors baithta hai. Exam point: Assembly of Brahmin landowning proprietors - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Kalidasa's masterwork drama 'Abhigyana Shakuntalam' dramatizes the romance of Shakuntala with which king?
qh: कालिदास का सबसे प्रसिद्ध नाटक 'अभिज्ञान शाकुन्तलम' किनके बीच की प्रेम कहानी है?
e: Abhigyana Shakuntalam Hastinapur ke King Dushyanta aur Kanva rishi ki ashram-kanya Shakuntala ki prem katha hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kalidas ka sabase prasiddh natak 'abhijnan shakuntalam' kinake bich ki prem kahani hai? Isi aadhar par King Dushyanta and Shakuntala chuna jaata hai. Rama and Sita, Pururavas and Urvashi, Arjuna and Subhadra anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad King Dushyanta and Shakuntala hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: King Dushyanta and Shakuntala - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The Chinese Buddhist pilgrim Faxian highlighted the harsh social ostracization faced by which community in India?
qh: चीनी तीर्थयात्री 'फ़ाह्यान' ने किन लोगों की दुर्दशा का वर्णन किया है, जिन्हें शहर के बाहर रहना पड़ता था?
e: Faxian ne note kiya ki Chandalas ko shahar se bahar rehna padta tha aur shahar me aate waqt wood click karke sound karna padta tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki chini tirthayatri 'phahyan' ne kin logon ki durdasha ka varnan kiya hai, jinhein shahar ke bahar rahana padata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Untouchables (Chandalas) hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Foreign merchants, Weavers, Monastery guards alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Untouchables (Chandalas) hai. Exam point: Untouchables (Chandalas) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In the municipal guilds of the Gupta period, who was designated as the 'Sarthavaha'?
qh: गुप्त काल के प्रशासन में 'सार्थवाह' (Sarthavaha) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: Leader of the traveling merchant caravans
e: Sarthavaha long-distance trading caravan ke leader aur guide ko kaha jata tha jo town administrative boards me bhi rehte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki gupt kal ke prashasan mein 'sarthavah' (Sarthavaha) kise kaha jata tha? Isi baat se Leader of the traveling merchant caravans sahi sabit hota hai. Record keeper, Head artisan master, Chief judicial banker is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Leader of the traveling merchant caravans hai. Exam point: Leader of the traveling merchant caravans - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which Chinese pilgrim spent extensive years studying and recording the court of Harshavardhana?
qh: हर्षवर्धन के शासनकाल में कौन सा प्रसिद्ध चीनी यात्री भारत आया था?
e: Xuanzang Harsha ke reign me India aaye the aur unhone Kannauj assembly aur Nalanda University ka vivid account diya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki harshavardhan ke shasanakal mein kaun sa prasiddh chini yatri bharat aya tha? Isi karan se Xuanzang (Hsuan-tsang) sahi uttar hai. Faxian, Yijing, Megasthenes is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Xuanzang (Hsuan-tsang) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Xuanzang (Hsuan-tsang) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the village headman called in the northern agrarian plains during the post-Mauryan and Gupta periods?
qh: मौर्योत्तर काल में भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के उत्तरी भाग में गाँव के प्रधान व्यक्ति को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: North India me gaon ka hereditary chief Gramabhojaka kehlata tha jo village ka sabse bada landowner aur tax collector hota tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki mauryottar kal mein bharatiy upamahadvip ke uttari bhag mein ganv ke pradhan vyakti ko kya kaha jata tha? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Gramabhojaka hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vellalar, Grihapati, Kadaisiyar is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Gramabhojaka hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Gramabhojaka - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In ancient Tamil Sangam terminology, what were large prosperous landowners called?
qh: तमिल क्षेत्र में बड़े भूस्वामियों को प्राचीन काल में किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Sangam society me rich aur influential land-owning class ko Vellalar kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki tamil kshetr mein badae bhusvamiyon ko prachin kal mein kis nam se jana jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Vellalar sahi hai. Uzhavar, Gramabhojaka, Adimai in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Vellalar hai. Exam point: Vellalar - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In ancient South India, which socio-economic class was designated by the term 'Adimai'?
qh: प्राचीन काल में 'अदिमई' (Adimai) शब्द का प्रयोग किनके लिए किया जाता था?
e: Tamilakam me landless labourers ko Kadaisiyar aur household slaves ko Adimai kaha jata tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki prachin kal mein 'adimai' (Adimai) shabd ka prayog kinake lie kiya jata tha? Isi aadhar par Agricultural landless laborers and slaves chuna jaata hai. Guild financiers, Independent cultivators, Temple priests mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Agricultural landless laborers and slaves hai. Exam point: Agricultural landless laborers and slaves - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What were small independent freeholding farmers referred to as in Northern India?
qh: उत्तर भारत में स्वतंत्र छोटे किसानों को क्या कहा जाता था, जिनके पास अपनी कम भूमि होती थी?
e: Chhote independent farmers jinke paas apni land hoti thi unhe North India me Grihapatis kaha jata tha. Prashn yah batata hai ki uttar bharat mein svatantr chhote kisanon ko kya kaha jata tha, jinake pas apani kam bhumi hoti thi? Isliye sahi nateeja Grihapatis nikalta hai. Dasa karmakara, Gramabhojaka, Uzhavar alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Grihapatis baithta hai. Exam point: Grihapatis - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: In which city were the famous literary academies (Sangams) of ancient Tamil poets organized?
qh: संगम साहित्य की रचना और संकलन किस शहर की सभाओं (Sangams) में किया गया था?
e: Pandya kings ke patronage me Tamil poets ki assembly (Sangam) Madurai me organize hui thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki sangam sahity ki rachana aur sankalan kis shahar ki sabhaon (Sangams) mein kiya gaya tha? Isliye antim jawab Madurai ke roop mein milta hai. Baaki vikalp - Kaveripattinam, Puhar, Chennai - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isi wajah se Madurai sahi hai. Exam point: Madurai - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: What civic purpose was served by the ceramic 'Ring Wells' uncovered in early historical urban centers?
qh: पुरातत्वविदों को खुदाई में 'वलय कूप' (Ring Wells) मिले हैं, इनका मुख्य उपयोग क्या था?
o: Domestic soak pits, drains, and latrines
e: Ring wells ceramic rings ko stack karke banaye jaate the jo domestic soak-pits, drains ya latrines ki tarah use hote the. Prashn yah batata hai ki puratatvavidon ko khudai mein 'valay kup' (Ring Wells) mile hain, inaka mukhy upayog kya tha? Isi aadhar par Domestic soak pits, drains, and latrines chuna jaata hai. Temple ritual altars, Grain storage vaults, Coin-minting moulds alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Domestic soak pits, drains, and latrines hai. Exam point: Domestic soak pits, drains, and latrines - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Mathura functioned as the prosperous second capital of which Central Asian imperial dynasty?
qh: प्राचीन व्यापारिक मार्गों के संगम पर स्थित 'मथुरा' किस वंश की दूसरी राजधानी बनी थी?
e: Kushana empire ki primary capital Purushapura (Peshawar) thi aur second capital Mathura thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki prachin vyaparik margon ke sangam par sthit 'mathura' kis vansh ki dusari rajadhani bani thi? Isi karan se Kushanas sahi uttar hai. Vikalp Mauryas, Guptas, Sungas bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Kushanas hi milti hai. Exam point: Kushanas - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: How were ancient Indian 'Punch-Marked Coins' (Aahat coins) typically manufactured?
qh: आहत सिक्के (Punch Marked Coins) सामान्यतः किस आकार के होते थे और उन्हें कैसे बनाया जाता था?
o: Punching geometric/natural symbols on cut silver/copper metal flans
e: Metal sheets ko cut karke punches se symbols (tree, sun, hill) impress karke Aahat (Punch-marked) coins banaye jaate the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ahat sikke (Punch Marked Coins) samanyatah kis akar ke hote the aur unhein kaise banaya jata tha? Isi tathya par Punching geometric/natural symbols on cut silver/copper metal... tika hua hai. Pouring molten brass in clay, Mould-cast in baked mud, Woodblock printing in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Punching geometric/natural symbols on cut silver/copper metal... hi milti hai. Exam point: Punching geometric/natural symbols on cut silver/copper metal flans - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: What were the mercantile and artisan guilds known as during the early historical urban period?
qh: शिल्पकारों और व्यापारियों द्वारा बनाए गए संगठनों को प्राचीन काल में क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Artisans aur merchants ke economic associations ko Shrenis kehte the jo training, production aur banks ka kaam karti thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki shilpakaron aur vyapariyon dvara banae gae sangathanon ko prachin kal mein kya kaha jata tha? sabha gaon ya janapad ki badi sabha thi jismein bade log baithte the. Isi karan se Shrenis sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Gopa, Sabha, Sangha - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Shrenis hi hai. Exam point: Shrenis - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The exquisite, lustrous pottery known as 'Northern Black Polished Ware' (NBPW) belongs to which historical era?
qh: उत्तर भारत में पाए जाने वाले 'उत्तरी काले चमकीले पात्र' (NBPW) किस काल की प्रमुख विशेषता हैं?
e: NBPW high-quality glossy black luxury pottery thi jo second urbanization (Mahajanapada aur Mauryan era) me flourish hui. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki uttar bharat mein pae jane vale 'uttari kale chamakile patr' (NBPW) kis kal ki pramukh visheshata hain? mahajanapada chhathi shatabdi isvi purv ke bade janapad the jahan se rajkumar raj karte the. Isliye antim jawab Mahajanapada and Mauryan Urban Phase ke roop mein milta hai. Mughal era, Mesolithic era, Early Harappan phase anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Mahajanapada and Mauryan Urban Phase hi hai. Exam point: Mahajanapada and Mauryan Urban Phase - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What was the prominent historical identity of 'Arikamedu' located near Puducherry?
qh: पुडुचेरी में स्थित 'अरिकामेडु' (Arikamedu) प्राचीन काल में किस रूप में प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Arikamedu Coromandel coast par Indo-Roman trade ka major coastal port tha jahan ships aakar unload hoti thi. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki puducheri mein sthit 'arikamedu' (Arikamedu) prachin kal mein kis rup mein prasiddh tha? Isi karan se Indo-Roman coastal trading port sahi uttar hai. Imperial capital, Religious monastery, Naval fortress is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav Indo-Roman coastal trading port hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Indo-Roman coastal trading port - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which foreign Roman luxury wares were unearthed during excavations at Arikamedu?
qh: अरिकामेडु से किस विदेशी सभ्यता के अवशेष जैसे 'एमफोरा' और 'एरेटाइन' पात्र मिले हैं?
o: Roman Amphorae and stamped Arretine pottery
e: Arikamedu se Roman wine containers (Amphorae) aur Italy ke Arezzo me bani stamped Arretine pottery mili hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki arikamedu se kis videshi sabhyata ke avashesh jaise 'emaphora' aur 'eretain' patr mile hain? Isi karan se Roman Amphorae and stamped Arretine pottery sahi uttar hai. Galti Attic Greek black figures, Egyptian glass cups, Chinese celadon bowls chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad Roman Amphorae and stamped Arretine pottery hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Roman Amphorae and stamped Arretine pottery - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which prized South Indian spice was termed 'Black Gold' in the Roman Empire?
qh: रोमन अंपायर में भारत के किस मसाले की इतनी माँग थी कि उसे 'काला सोना' (Black Gold) कहा जाता था?
e: Roman Empire me Indian Black Pepper (kali mirch) ki demand bohot high thi, isliye use 'Black Gold' (Yavanapriya) kaha gaya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki roman anpayar mein bharat ke kis masale ki itani mang thi ki use 'kala sona' (Black Gold) kaha jata tha? Isi karan se Black Pepper sahi uttar hai. Cardamom, Cloves, Cinnamon in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Black Pepper hai. Exam point: Black Pepper - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What political title does Sangam literature use to denote the three crowned dynasties (Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas)?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के तीन शासक परिवारों - चोल, चेर और पाण्ड्य के लिए संगम साहित्य में किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया गया है?
e: Tamil word 'Muvendar' ka matlab 'Three Chiefs' hota hai jo Chola, Chera aur Pandya rulers ke liye use hua hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki dakshin bharat ke tin shasak parivaron - chol, cher aur pandy ke lie sangam sahity mein kis shabd ka prayog kiya gaya hai? Isliye sahi nateeja Muvendar nikalta hai. Chakravartin, Samanta, Rajaraja is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Muvendar hai. Exam point: Muvendar - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Which prosperous cultural city served as the historic royal capital of the Pandyas?
qh: पाण्ड्य शासकों की राजधानी कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Madurai Vaigai nadi ke kinare Pandya kings ki capital aur pearl trade ka main center tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki pandy shasakon ki rajadhani kahan sthit thi? Yahi wajah hai ki Madurai sahi hai. Puhar, Kanchipuram, Thanjavur is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Madurai baithta hai. Exam point: Madurai - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: Who is celebrated as the greatest ruler of the Deccan-based Satavahana dynasty?
qh: पश्चिमी भारत में सातवाहन वंश का सबसे प्रमुख राजा कौन था?
e: Gautamiputra Shri Satakarni ne Shakas ko defeat karke Satavahana power ko restore kiya tha. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki pashchimi bharat mein satavahan vansh ka sabase pramukh raja kaun tha? Isliye antim jawab Gautamiputra Shri Satakarni ke roop mein milta hai. Simuka, Kanishka, Pushyamitra Sunga in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Gautamiputra Shri Satakarni hi hai. Exam point: Gautamiputra Shri Satakarni - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: By what grand sovereign title were the Satavahana kings known in ancient inscriptions?
qh: सातवाहन शासकों को निम्नलिखित में से किस उपाधि से जाना जाता था?
e: Satavahana rulers south-bound trade routes ko control karte the, isliye unhe 'Dakshinapatha-pati' (Lords of Dakshinapatha) kaha gaya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki satavahan shasakon ko nimnalikhit mein se kis upadhi se jana jata tha? Isi karan se Lords of Dakshinapatha sahi uttar hai. Lords of Uttarapatha, Gangaikonda, Magadhapati mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Lords of Dakshinapatha hi milti hai. Exam point: Lords of Dakshinapatha - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which powerful dynasty gained paramount control over the strategic northern branches of the Silk Route?
qh: प्राचीन व्यापार के संदर्भ में 'सिल्क रूट' (Silk Route) पर नियंत्रण रखने वाले सबसे प्रसिद्ध शासक कौन थे?
e: Kushanas ne Central Asia se North India tak faili Silk Route ko control kiya aur heavy trade taxes collect kiye. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki prachin vyapar ke sandarbh mein 'silk rut' (Silk Route) par niyantran rakhane vale sabase prasiddh shasak kaun the? Isi karan se Kushanas sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Mauryas, Satavahanas, Pallavas - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Kushanas hai. Exam point: Kushanas - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Who founded the Mauryan Empire around 321 BCE with the strategic guidance of Chanakya?
qh: मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना लगभग 2300 साल पहले किसने की थी?
e: Chandragupta Maurya ne Chanakya ki madad se Nanda dynasty ko overthrow karke Mauryan Empire establish kiya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki maury samrajy ki sthapana lagabhag 2300 sal pahale kisane ki thi? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Yahi wajah hai ki Chandragupta Maurya sahi hai. Ashoka, Bindusara, Mahapadma Nanda mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Ant mein sahi chunav Chandragupta Maurya hi thehrta hai. Exam point: Chandragupta Maurya - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What is the title of the statecraft manual compiled by Chanakya (Kautilya)?
qh: चाणक्य (कौटिल्य) द्वारा लिखित प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Kautilya ne state governance, economic policy aur diplomacy par comprehensive treatise 'Arthashastra' likha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki chanaky (kautily) dvara likhit prasiddh pustak ka nam kya hai? arthashastra Kautilya ki wo kitaab hai jo rajya chalane ki niti batati hai. In tathyon ke chalte Arthashastra hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Indica, Mudrarakshasa, Rajatarangini - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se Arthashastra sahi hai. Exam point: Arthashastra - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which Greek ambassador was stationed by Seleucus I Nicator at the court of Chandragupta Maurya?
qh: यूनानी राजा सेल्यूकस निकेटर ने चंद्रगुप्त मौर्य के दरबार में किस राजदूत को भेजा था?
e: Megasthenes Seleucid ambassador the jinhone Mauryan administration aur society par apni book 'Indica' likhi. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki yunani raja selyukas niketar ne chandragupt maury ke darabar mein kis rajadut ko bheja tha? Chandragupta Maurya vansh ka sansthapak tha jisne Magadh se badi satta khadi ki. Yahi wajah hai ki Megasthenes sahi hai. Faxian, Dionysius, Deimachus ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Megasthenes hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Megasthenes - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Following the devastation of which war did Emperor Ashoka renounce conquest by war for conquest by Dhamma?
qh: सम्राट अशोक ने किस युद्ध के बाद हिंसा का त्याग कर 'धम्म' का मार्ग अपनाया था?
e: Kalinga war me hue massive carnage aur bloodshed ko dekhkar Ashoka ne bherighosha ko dhammaghosha me convert kiya. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki samrat ashok ne kis yuddh ke bad hinsa ka tyag kar 'dhamm' ka marg apanaya tha? dhamma Ashok ke wo aadesh the jo lok-updesh tatha sahi aacharan batate the. Isliye antim jawab Kalinga War ke roop mein milta hai. Galti Battle of Panipat, Battle of Hydaspes, Battle of Buxar chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Kalinga War baithta hai. Exam point: Kalinga War - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: In which language and script were the majority of Ashoka's public royal edicts issued?
qh: अशोक के अधिकतर अभिलेख किस भाषा और लिपि में लिखे गए हैं?
e: Ashoka ke major rock edicts aam janta ki bhasha Prakrit me aur Brahmi script me engraved the. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ashok ke adhikatar abhilekh kis bhasha aur lipi mein likhe gae hain? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isliye sahi nateeja Prakrit language in Brahmi script nikalta hai. Vikalp Pali language in Kharosthi script, Sanskrit and Brahmi, Greek language in Aramaic script bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Prakrit language in Brahmi script hi hai. Exam point: Prakrit language in Brahmi script - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What special cadre of officials was commissioned by Ashoka to inculcate ethical principles of Dhamma?
qh: अशोक ने अपने 'धम्म' के संदेश को फैलाने के लिए किन अधिकारियों की नियुक्ति की थी?
e: Ashoka ne 'Dhamma Mahamatta' namak special moral officers appoint kiye jo society me Dhamma propagate karte the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki ashok ne apane 'dhamm' ke sandesh ko phailane ke lie kin adhikariyon ki niyukti ki thi? dhamma Ashok ke wo aadesh the jo lok-updesh tatha sahi aacharan batate the. Isi aadhar par Dhamma Mahamattas chuna jaata hai. Rajukas, Senapatis, Samahartas alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Dhamma Mahamattas hi milti hai. Exam point: Dhamma Mahamattas - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The ancient province of Kalinga conquered by Ashoka forms part of which modern Indian state?
qh: अशोक का कलिंग (Kalinga) क्षेत्र वर्तमान में किस भारतीय राज्य का हिस्सा है?
e: Ancient Kalinga coastal Odisha aur northern Andhra Pradesh ke geographical belt ko represent karta hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki ashok ka kaling (Kalinga) kshetr vartaman mein kis bharatiy rajy ka hissa hai? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isliye antim jawab Odisha ke roop mein milta hai. Vikalp Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Odisha hi milti hai. Exam point: Odisha - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Mauryan emperor erected the Lion Capital at Sarnath, adopted as the National Emblem of India?
qh: सारनाथ में स्थित चार शेरों वाला स्तंभ शीर्ष (Lion Capital) किस सम्राट द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
e: Emperor Ashoka ne Buddha ke first sermon ki memory me Sarnath me four-lion capital pillar banwaya tha. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki saranath mein sthit char sheron vala stanbh shirsh (Lion Capital) kis samrat dvara banavaya gaya tha? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isi baat se Ashoka sahi sabit hota hai. Baaki vikalp - Bindusara, Brihadratha, Chandragupta Maurya - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ashoka hi milti hai. Exam point: Ashoka - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: In the Mauryan administrative framework, what distinguished 'Tribute' (Nazrana) from regular 'Taxes' (Kara)?
qh: मौर्य शासन के दौरान 'नज़राना' (Tribute) और 'कर' (Tax) में क्या अंतर था?
o: Tribute was collected exclusively in coinage
Taxes were voluntary gifts, while tribute was mandatory
Both terms were identical in revenue codes
Taxes were collected on a regular basis, while tribute was collected irregularly when possible
e: Taxes regular revenue assessments the, jabki Tribute variety of commodities ke form me irregularly collect hota tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki maury shasan ke dauran 'najarana' (Tribute) aur 'kar' (Tax) mein kya antar tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Taxes were collected on a regular basis,... sahi nikalta hai. Tribute was collected exclusively in coinage, Taxes were voluntary gifts, while tribute was mandatory, Both terms were identical in revenue codes ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Taxes were collected on a regular basis, while tribute was collected irregularly when possible hi hai. Exam point: Taxes were collected on a regular basis, while tribute was collected irregularly when possible - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: According to Megasthenes, in what ceremonial vehicle was the Mauryan Emperor borne during royal public appearances?
qh: मेगास्थनीज के अनुसार, सम्राट के सार्वजनिक रूप से आने पर उन्हें किस प्रकार के पालकी में ले जाया जाता था?
e: Megasthenes ne note kiya ki royal public processions me Mauryan emperor ko ornamented Golden Palanquin me carry kiya jata tha. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki megasthanij ke anusar, samrat ke sarvajanik rup se ane par unhein kis prakar ke palaki mein le jaya jata tha? Isi baat se Golden Palanquin sahi sabit hota hai. Timber sedan, Silver chariot, Ivory carriage is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Golden Palanquin hai. Exam point: Golden Palanquin - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: The city of Taxila stood as the strategic gateway to which territorial quarter of the Mauryan realm?
qh: तक्षशिला मौर्य साम्राज्य के किस दिशा का केंद्र या गेटवे (Gateway) था?
e: Taxila northwestern trade routes aur Central Asia ke transit corridor par positioned gateway city thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki takshashila maury samrajy ke kis disha ka keindr ya getave (Gateway) tha? Isliye antim jawab North-West and Central Asia ke roop mein milta hai. Southern Deccan ports, Eastern Bay of Bengal, Sri Lankan maritime trade is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad North-West and Central Asia hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: North-West and Central Asia - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which of the following practices was strictly NOT an element of Emperor Ashoka's moral Dhamma?
qh: अशोक के 'धम्म' में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी बात शामिल नहीं थी?
o: Mandatory animal sacrifice and complex rituals to appease gods
Compassionate treatment of servants and prisoners
e: Ashoka ke Dhamma me rituals, yajnas aur animal sacrifice ko reject kiya gaya tha aur ethical conduct par stress tha. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki ashok ke 'dhamm' mein nimnalikhit mein se kaun si bat shamil nahin thi? dhamma Ashok ke wo aadesh the jo lok-updesh tatha sahi aacharan batate the. Isi karan se Mandatory animal sacrifice and complex rituals to... sahi uttar hai. Galti Compassionate treatment of servants and prisoners, Ahimsa towards all living beings, Obedience to parents and elders chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Mandatory animal sacrifice and complex rituals to... hi milti hai. Exam point: Mandatory animal sacrifice and complex rituals to appease gods - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which Hellenistic royal lineages consolidated power over Northwest India following the retreat of the Mauryas?
qh: मौर्य साम्राज्य के पतन के बाद लगभग 2000 साल पहले उत्तर-पश्चिम में किन राजाओं का शासन स्थापित हुआ?
e: Mauryan decline ke baad northwest me Indo-Greeks (Bactrian Greeks) ne coins aur administrative kingdoms set up kiye. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki maury samrajy ke patan ke bad lagabhag 2000 sal pahale uttar-pashchim mein kin rajaon ka shasan sthapit hua? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Indo-Greeks (Bactrian Greeks) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Pallavas, Cholas, Mughals chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isi wajah se Indo-Greeks (Bactrian Greeks) sahi hai. Exam point: Indo-Greeks (Bactrian Greeks) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which children of Ashoka were sent to Sri Lanka to propagate the Buddhist teachings?
qh: अशोक ने अपने धम्म का संदेश सीरिया और मिस्र जैसे विदेशों में भी भेजा था, इसमें उनका पुत्र और पुत्री कौन थे?
e: Ashoka ne apne son Mahendra aur daughter Sanghamitra ko Bodhi tree ki branch ke sath Sri Lanka bheja tha. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki ashok ne apane dhamm ka sandesh siriya aur misr jaise videshon mein bhi bheja tha, isamein unaka putr aur putri kaun the? Ashoka Maurya vansh ka badshah tha jo dhamma ke prachar tatha shake par apni niti ke liye jaana jaata hai. Isi aadhar par Mahendra and Sanghamitra chuna jaata hai. Rahul and Yashodhara, Kunal and Subhadrangi, Ajatashatru and Rohini is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Mahendra and Sanghamitra hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Mahendra and Sanghamitra - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Under Mauryan imperial governance, which territory was under the immediate, direct administration of the Emperor?
qh: मौर्य प्रशासन में पाटलिपुत्र के आस-पास के क्षेत्र पर किसका सीधा नियंत्रण होता था?
e: Imperial capital Pataliputra aur surrounding core territory direct central emperor ke control me hoti thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki maury prashasan mein pataliputr ke as-pas ke kshetr par kisaka sidha niyantran hota tha? In tathyon ke chalte The Emperor directly hi sahi hai. Senapatis in transit, Ministers of foreign frontiers, Provincial Governors (Kumaras) ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar The Emperor directly hi hai. Exam point: The Emperor directly - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What forest resources were tribal forest dwellers expected to render to Mauryan officials?
qh: मौर्य काल में जंगलों में रहने वाले लोगों से क्या उम्मीद की जाती थी?
e: Forest tribes state ko war elephants, timber, raw honey aur wax provide karte the as customary tribute. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki maury kal mein jangalon mein rahane vale logon se kya ummid ki jati thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Elephants, timber, honey, and beeswax hi sahi baithta hai. Minted coins, Stonemasonry sculptures, Agricultural paddy tributes ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Elephants, timber, honey, and beeswax sahi hai. Exam point: Elephants, timber, honey, and beeswax - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: To which warrior clan (Gana) did Siddhartha Gautama belong prior to renouncing his princely life?
qh: गौतम बुद्ध का संबंध किस गण (Clan) से था?
e: Gautama Buddha Kapilavastu ke Sakya kshatriya clan se belong karte the, isliye unhe 'Shakyamuni' bhi kehte hain. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki gautam buddh ka sanbandh kis gan (Clan) se tha? gana ek samooh shasan wali vyavastha thi jismein sabhi sadasya milkar faisle karte the. Isi karan se Sakya Gana sahi uttar hai. Malla Gana, Kuru clan, Licchavi Gana alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Sakya Gana hi milti hai. Exam point: Sakya Gana - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In Buddhist philosophical doctrine, what does the term 'Tanha' denote as the root cause of human suffering?
qh: बुद्ध की शिक्षाओं के अनुसार 'तन्हा' (तृष्णा) का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Buddha ne explain kiya ki unending desires aur cravings ('Tanha') hi manushya ke saare dukkha ka mool karan hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki buddh ki shikshaon ke anusar 'tanha' (trishna) ka kya arth hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Incessant craving or insatiable desire hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Physical illness, Anger, Ignorance of scriptures is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Incessant craving or insatiable desire hai. Exam point: Incessant craving or insatiable desire - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: In which vernacular dialect did Gautama Buddha preach so that ordinary masses could comprehend his teachings?
qh: बुद्ध ने अपनी शिक्षाएँ सामान्य लोगों को किस भाषा में दी थीं?
e: Elite Sanskrit ke bajay Buddha ne aam janta ki spoken dialect Prakrit (Magadhi Prakrit) me preach kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki buddh ne apani shikshaen samany logon ko kis bhasha mein di thin? Isi karan se Prakrit sahi uttar hai. Galti Classical Sanskrit, Avahattha, Persian chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Prakrit hi hai. Exam point: Prakrit - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What fundamental universal truth was taught by Gautama Buddha through the parable of Kisa Gotami?
qh: किसा गौतमी की कहानी बुद्ध ने क्या सिखाने के लिए सुनाई थी?
o: The universality and inevitability of death for all living beings
e: Mustard seed mangwa kar Buddha ne Kisa Gotami ko sikhaya ki mrityu har ghar me hoti hai aur death sabke liye unavoidable hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki kisa gautami ki kahani buddh ne kya sikhane ke lie sunai thi? Yahi wajah hai ki The universality and inevitability of death for all living beings sahi hai. Law of karma and rebirth, The merits of ritual sacrifice, Praising wealth ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isi wajah se The universality and inevitability of death for all living beings sahi hai. Exam point: The universality and inevitability of death for all living beings - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What did the Upanishadic seers deduce regarding the ultimate identity of 'Atman' and 'Brahman'?
qh: उपनिषदों के विचारकों का मानना था कि अंततः 'आत्मा' और 'ब्रह्म' क्या हैं?
o: Ultimately identical and one with the universal soul
e: Upanishads ka core philosophy 'Aham Brahmasmi' aur 'Tat Tvam Asi' hai-individual soul (Atman) aur universal soul (Brahman) ek hi hain. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki upanishadon ke vicharakon ka manana tha ki antatah 'atma' aur 'brahm' kya hain? Isi karan se Ultimately identical and one with the universal soul sahi uttar hai. Imaginary concepts, Mortal material products, Two irreconcilable entities anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Ultimately identical and one with the universal soul hi hai. Exam point: Ultimately identical and one with the universal soul - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Who was Gargi Vachaknavi, highlighted in the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad?
qh: प्रसिद्ध उपनिषद विचारक 'गार्गी' कौन थीं?
o: A renowned woman philosopher who debated sage Yajnavalkya
e: Gargi ek highly learned lady scholar thi jinhone King Janaka ke court me sage Yajnavalkya ke sath philosophical debate kiya tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki prasiddh upanishad vicharak 'gargi' kaun thin? upanishad wo granth hain jismein gyaan tatha brahma ke baare mein vichar milta hai. Yahi wajah hai ki A renowned woman philosopher who debated sage Yajnavalkya sahi hai. An ascetic nun of Jainism, A palace maid, A reigning queen mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan A renowned woman philosopher who debated sage... hi milti hai. Exam point: A renowned woman philosopher who debated sage Yajnavalkya - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What uncompromising interpretation of 'Ahimsa' was mandated for Jain practitioners?
qh: जैन धर्म के अनुयायियों के लिए 'अहिंसा' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Absolute non-injury and preservation of all forms of living organisms
e: Jainism me Ahimsa absolute hai; microscopic organisms, insects aur plants samet kisi bhi living being ko anjaane me bhi hurt nahi karna chahiye. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki jain dharm ke anuyayiyon ke lie 'ahinsa' ka kya arth tha? Isliye sahi nateeja Absolute non-injury and preservation of all forms of living organisms nikalta hai. Refraining from human warfare only, Renouncing anger, Non-stealing alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Absolute non-injury and preservation of all forms... hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Absolute non-injury and preservation of all forms of living organisms - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the rigid monastic rules of Jainism find greater adherence among mercantile traders than agrarian peasants?
qh: जैन धर्म को मुख्य रूप से किस वर्ग का समर्थन प्राप्त था?
o: Farming inevitably involved ploughing and killing crop-damaging insects and pests
Traders were forced by kings to convert
Peasants could not afford white robes
e: Kisan ke liye ploughing karte waqt insects marna unavoidable tha, jabki traders bina living organisms ko kill kiye business manage kar sakte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki jain dharm ko mukhy rup se kis varg ka samarthan prapt tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Farming inevitably involved ploughing and killing crop-damaging insects and pests sahi hai. Vikalp Traders were forced by kings to convert, Peasants were barred from monasteries, Peasants could not afford white robes bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Farming inevitably involved ploughing and killing crop-damaging insects and pests hai. Exam point: Farming inevitably involved ploughing and killing crop-damaging insects and pests - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What were the rock-cut and brick-built monastic residential abodes of Buddhist monks called?
qh: बौद्ध और जैन भिक्षु जहाँ स्थायी रूप से निवास करते थे, उन्हें क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Monks aur nuns ke rainy season (Varshavasa) me permanent rehne ke residential monasteries ko Viharas kaha gaya. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki bauddh aur jain bhikshu jahan sthayi rup se nivas karate the, unhein kya kaha jata tha? Isi baat se Viharas sahi sabit hota hai. Mandapas, Stupas, Chaityas in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Viharas hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Viharas - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which ancient scholar composed the landmark foundational Sanskrit grammar titled 'Ashtadhyayi'?
qh: संस्कृत व्याकरण की रचना करने वाले प्रसिद्ध विद्वान कौन थे?
e: Panini ne Sanskrit bhasha ke rules aur phonetics ko mathematically arrange karke 'Ashtadhyayi' grammar compose kiya. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki sanskrit vyakaran ki rachana karane vale prasiddh vidvan kaun the? Isi tathya par Panini tika hua hai. Bhartrihari, Kalidasa, Chanakya is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Panini hai. Exam point: Panini - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: At which site in Gujarat were the canonical teachings of Jainism formally committed to manuscript writing around 500 CE?
qh: जैन धर्म की शिक्षाएँ वर्तमान में गुजरात के किस स्थान पर उपलब्ध हैं?
e: Second Jain Council (~500 CE) Valabhi (Gujarat) me hui jahan oral traditions ko manuscripts me systematically write down kiya gaya. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki jain dharm ki shikshaen vartaman mein gujarat ke kis sthan par upalabdh hain? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Valabhi hi sahi baithta hai. Lothal, Somnath, Surat is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Valabhi hai. Exam point: Valabhi - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The Zend Avesta contains the sacred teachings of which ancient Iranian prophet?
qh: अवेस्ता (Avesta) किस ईरानी पैगंबर की शिक्षाओं का संकलन है?
e: Prophet Zoroaster (Zarathustra) ke hymns aur ethical teachings Persian sacred scripture Zend Avesta me milti hain. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki avesta (Avesta) kis irani paiganbar ki shikshaon ka sankalan hai? Isi karan se Zoroaster (Zarathustra) sahi uttar hai. Mani, Confucius, Laozi is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar Zoroaster (Zarathustra) hai. Exam point: Zoroaster (Zarathustra) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What was the royal horse sacrifice ritual performed by kings to establish imperial suzerainty during the Later Vedic period?
qh: उत्तर वैदिक काल (Later Vedic Period) में राजा बनने के लिए किए जाने वाले सबसे प्रसिद्ध यज्ञ का नाम क्या था?
e: Ashvamedha Yajna me consecrated horse ko territory claim karne ke liye roam karne chhod diya jata tha aur rokne wale ko yuddh karna padta tha. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki uttar vaidik kal (Later Vedic Period) mein raja banane ke lie kie jane vale sabase prasiddh yajn ka nam kya tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Ashvamedha hi sahi baithta hai. Putrakameshti, Agnishtoma, Vajapeya is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Ashvamedha hi hai. Exam point: Ashvamedha - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What does the political term 'Janapada' literally signify in its ancient historical origin?
qh: वैदिक काल में 'जनपद' शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: The foothold where a clan/tribe (jana) settled down
e: Janapada ka literal meaning hai 'wo bhoomi jahan Jana (tribe) ne apna pair (pada) rakha aur settle ho gaye'. Prashn yah batata hai ki vaidik kal mein 'janapad' shabd ka shabdik arth kya hai? janapada jan-basti tatha rajyakshetra ko kaha jaata tha. Isi karan se The foothold where a clan/tribe (jana) settled down sahi uttar hai. Fortified citadel, Sacrificial ground, Military drill ground ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad The foothold where a clan/tribe (jana) settled down hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: The foothold where a clan/tribe (jana) settled down - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Into how many hierarchical Varna orders did the Later Vedic priesthood classify human society?
qh: उत्तर वैदिक काल में समाज को कितने वर्णों में विभाजित किया गया था?
e: Later Vedic society ko four varnas me divide kiya gaya: Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas aur Shudras. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki uttar vaidik kal mein samaj ko kitane varnon mein vibhajit kiya gaya tha? varna samaj ke chaar bade samooh - brahman, kshatriya, vaishya tatha shudra - the. Isi karan se Four sahi uttar hai. Baaki vikalp - Three, Six, Two - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yah sab dekhkar sahi uttar Four baithta hai. Exam point: Four - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which social Varnas retained the religious eligibility to perform and patronize Vedic sacrifices?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किन वर्णों को यज्ञ करने का अधिकार प्राप्त था?
e: Upper three varnas (Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya) upanayana sanskar aur Vedic yajnas perform karne ke eligible the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki nimnalikhit mein se kin varnon ko yajn karane ka adhikar prapt tha? vedic kaal woh samay hai jab ved tatha yagya-karm pramukh the. Isi tathya par Brahmins, Kshatriyas, and Vaishyas (Dvijas) tika hua hai. Vikalp All Varnas including Shudras, Brahmins only, Brahmins and Kshatriyas only bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Brahmins, Kshatriyas, and Vaishyas (Dvijas) hi milti hai. Exam point: Brahmins, Kshatriyas, and Vaishyas (Dvijas) - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which diagnostic ceramic ware with geometric decorations characterizes the Janapada archaeological period?
qh: पुरातात्विक खुदाई में जनपदों से किस प्रकार के विशिष्ट बर्तन मिले हैं?
e: Later Vedic Janapada sites (Hastinapur, Atranjikhera) se Painted Grey Ware (PGW) pottery broad level par mili hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki puratatvik khudai mein janapadon se kis prakar ke vishisht bartan mile hain? janapada jan-basti tatha rajyakshetra ko kaha jaata tha. Isi baat se Painted Grey Ware (PGW) sahi sabit hota hai. Vikalp Ochre Coloured Pottery, Black and Red Ware, Rouletted Ware bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Painted Grey Ware (PGW) hi hai. Exam point: Painted Grey Ware (PGW) - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Around 2500 years ago, what designation was applied to the consolidated, large territorial kingdoms?
qh: लगभग 2500 साल पहले कुछ जनपद अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हो गए, उन्हें क्या कहा जाने लगा?
e: Major Janapadas jinhone territory expand karke fortified capitals banayi, unhe 16 Mahajanapadas kaha gaya. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki lagabhag 2500 sal pahale kuchh janapad adhik mahatvapurn ho gae, unhein kya kaha jane laga? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Mahajanapadas hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Mahanagaras, Janatas, Samrajyas ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Mahajanapadas hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Mahajanapadas - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Why did the sovereign monarchs of the Mahajanapadas encircle their capital cities with monumental fortification walls?
qh: महाजनपदों के राजाओं ने अपनी राजधानियों के चारों ओर ऊँची दीवारें (किलेबंदी) क्यों बनवाई थीं?
o: Facilitating surveillance and civil control over the urban populace
e: Fortification security dene ke sath-sath king ki majesty show karne aur resource/people management ke liye ki jaati thi. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki mahajanapadon ke rajaon ne apani rajadhaniyon ke charon or unchi divarein (kilebandi) kyon banavai thin? Isliye sahi nateeja All of the above nikalta hai. Facilitating surveillance and civil control over the urban populace, Symbolizing royal prestige and wealth, Military defense against rival invasions ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Ant mein sahi chunav All of the above hi thehrta hai. Exam point: All of the above - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the standardized agricultural tax levied on crop harvests during the Mahajanapada era?
qh: महाजनपद काल में फसलों पर लगाए जाने वाले कर (Tax) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Produce ka regular 1/6th part tax ke form me state ko diya jata tha jise 'Bhaga' (share) kehte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki mahajanapad kal mein phasalon par lagae jane vale kar (Tax) ko kya kaha jata tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Bhaga (1/6th of produce) hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Bali, Kara, Shulka chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Sabhi baaton ke baad Bhaga (1/6th of produce) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Bhaga (1/6th of produce) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Alongside iron ploughshares, which agrarian technique multiplied crop yields during the 6th century BCE?
qh: महाजनपद काल में कृषि में आए दो बड़े बदलावों में से एक 'लोहे के हल' का प्रयोग था, दूसरा क्या था?
e: Broadcasting (seed chhidakne) ke bajay nursery me saplings prepare karke Paddy Transplantation shuru hua jisse crop survival aur yield shoot up ho gayi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mahajanapad kal mein krishi mein ae do badae badalavon mein se ek 'lohe ke hal' ka prayog tha, dusara kya tha? Isi tathya par Transplantation of paddy saplings tika hua hai. Galti Terrace canals, Mechanical harvesters, Chemical fertilizer irrigation chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isi wajah se Transplantation of paddy saplings sahi hai. Exam point: Transplantation of paddy saplings - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: Which Macedonian king advanced up to the river Beas (Hyphasis) before his army mutinied?
qh: मेसिडोनिया का वह राजा कौन था जो भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए ब्यास नदी तक पहुँच गया था?
e: Alexander the Great 326 BCE me Beas river tak aaya, par uski army ne Nanda empire ki mighty army ke darr aur thakan se aage badhne se mana kar diya. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki mesidoniya ka vah raja kaun tha jo bharat par akraman karane ke lie byas nadi tak pahunch gaya tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Alexander the Great sahi hai. Seleucus Nicator, Antiochus, Darius III is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Alexander the Great sahi hai. Exam point: Alexander the Great - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What was the institutional hallmark of a 'Gana' or 'Sangha' oligarchy like the Vajji confederacy?
qh: 'गण' या 'संघ' शासन व्यवस्था की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: Collective governance by a council of multiple co-rulers (Rajas) through assemblies
e: Gana/Sangha me absolute king nahi hota tha; multiple rajas assembly (Santhagara) me baithkar discussion aur voting se decisions lete the. Prashn yah batata hai ki 'gan' ya 'sangh' shasan vyavastha ki mukhy visheshata kya thi? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Collective governance by a council of multiple co-rulers (Rajas) through assemblies hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp Theocratic rule by high priests, Absence of administrative law, Single hereditary absolute monarch bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Collective governance by a council of multiple co-rulers (Rajas) through assemblies sahi hai. Exam point: Collective governance by a council of multiple... - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: Which revered Buddhist canonical text preserves the philosophical discourse and constitution of the Vajji Sangha?
qh: वज्जी संघ का वर्णन किस प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध ग्रंथ में मिलता है?
e: Sutta Pitaka ke Digha Nikaya me Ajatashatru ke minister Vassakara aur Buddha ke beech Vajji Sangha ki strengths par dialogue milta hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki vajji sangh ka varnan kis prasiddh bauddh granth mein milata hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Digha Nikaya hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Vikalp Dipavamsa, Mahavamsa, Milinda Panha bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Digha Nikaya hai. Exam point: Digha Nikaya - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What institutional infrastructure distinguished a Mahajanapada monarch from an early Rigvedic tribal chieftain?
qh: ऋग्वैदिक राजा और महाजनपद के राजा में मुख्य अंतर क्या था?
o: Fortified capital cities and palace architecture
Regular standing army maintained round the year
e: Rigvedic chiefs ke paas regular army aur fixed tax system nahi tha, jabki Mahajanapada kings standing army, fortified cities aur systematic taxes maintain karte the. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki rigvaidik raja aur mahajanapad ke raja mein mukhy antar kya tha? mahajanapada chhathi shatabdi isvi purv ke bade janapad the jahan se rajkumar raj karte the. In tathyon ke chalte All of the above hi sahi hai. Vikalp Fortified capital cities and palace architecture, Regular standing army maintained round the year, Systematic state tax extraction bureaucracy bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav All of the above hi thehrta hai. Exam point: All of the above - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Where were the monumental burnt-brick fortification ramparts discovered in ancient Kaushambi?
qh: कौशाम्बी (प्रयागराज) से मिली किलेबंदी की दीवार किससे बनी थी?
o: Massive baked bricks and dressed stone
e: Vatsa kingdom ki capital Kaushambi (Prayagraj ke paas) se massive kiln-burnt brick fortification wall unearth hui hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki kaushambi (prayagaraj) se mili kilebandi ki divar kisase bani thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Massive baked bricks and dressed stone sahi nikalta hai. Unbaked timber logs, Cast bronze rivets, Solid clay mortar ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Massive baked bricks and dressed stone hi hai. Exam point: Massive baked bricks and dressed stone - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Both Gautama Buddha and Vardhamana Mahavira hailed from which form of ancient political polities?
qh: बुद्ध और महावीर दोनों का संबंध निम्नलिखित में से किससे था?
e: Buddha (Sakya Gana) aur Mahavira (Jnatrika clan of Vajji) dono non-monarchical Gana-Sangha polities se aate the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki buddh aur mahavir donon ka sanbandh nimnalikhit mein se kisase tha? Isliye antim jawab Ganas or Sanghas (Oligarchic republics) ke roop mein milta hai. Imperial Cholas, Mauryan dynasty, Imperial Magadha alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Ganas or Sanghas (Oligarchic republics) hai. Exam point: Ganas or Sanghas (Oligarchic republics) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Roughly how many years ago was the earliest Sanskrit Veda, the Rigveda, composed?
qh: दुनिया के सबसे पुराने ग्रंथों में से एक 'ऋग्वेद' की रचना लगभग कितने वर्ष पूर्व हुई थी?
e: Rigveda ki compilation lagbhag 1500 BCE (aaj se kareeb 3500 saal pehle) Sapta Sindhu region me shuru hui thi. Prashn yah batata hai ki duniya ke sabase purane granthon mein se ek 'rigved' ki rachana lagabhag kitane varsh purv hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 3500 years ago sahi nikalta hai. Galti 3000 years ago, 4500 years ago, 2500 years ago chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 3500 years ago hai. Exam point: 3500 years ago - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: The Rigveda comprises over one thousand poetic hymns known as:
qh: ऋग्वेद में एक हज़ार से अधिक प्रार्थनाएँ हैं, उन्हें क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Rigveda ke 1028 devotional hymns ko 'Sukta' kaha jata hai jiska literal meaning hota hai 'well-said'. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki rigved mein ek hajar se adhik prarthanaen hain, unhein kya kaha jata hai? Isi baat se Suktas sahi sabit hota hai. Slokas, Mantras, Richas anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Suktas hai. Exam point: Suktas - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Which trio of divine entities occupied the foremost veneration in the Rigveda?
qh: ऋग्वेद में मुख्य रूप से किन तीन देवताओं का विशेष महत्व बताया गया है?
e: Rigveda ke major deities Agni (fire), Indra (warrior god) aur Soma (sacred plant juice) the. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki rigved mein mukhy rup se kin tin devataon ka vishesh mahatv bataya gaya hai? Prashn ke sabhi tathyon ko milane par Agni, Indra, and Soma hi sahi uttar nikalta hai. Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh, Surya, Chandra, and Vayu, Rama, Krishna, and Shiva in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Agni, Indra, and Soma hai. Exam point: Agni, Indra, and Soma - yah tathya bhoolna nahi chahiye.

qe: In which archaic linguistic form was the Rigveda composed and orally transmitted?
qh: ऋग्वेद की रचना किस भाषा में की गई है?
e: Rigveda archaic Vedic Sanskrit me composed hai jo classical Paninian Sanskrit se phonetically aur grammatically alag hai. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki rigved ki rachana kis bhasha mein ki gai hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Vedic Sanskrit sahi nikalta hai. Brahmi dialect, Magadhi, Classical Prakrit in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Vedic Sanskrit hi hai. Exam point: Vedic Sanskrit - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How was the Rigveda primarily preserved and transmitted across successive generations for centuries?
qh: ऋग्वेद के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
o: Through oral recitation and memorized listening (Shruti tradition)
e: Rigveda Shruti tradition ka part tha jise teachers aur students oral recitation aur auditory memorization se preserve karte the. Prashn yah batata hai ki rigved ke sandarbh mein nimnalikhit mein se kaun sa kathan sahi hai? In tathyon ke chalte Through oral recitation and memorized listening (Shruti tradition) hi sahi hai. Baaki vikalp - Through royal scrolls, Through mechanical paper printing, Through stone stele inscriptions - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Through oral recitation and memorized listening (Shruti tradition) hi milti hai. Exam point: Through oral recitation and memorized listening (Shruti... - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two sacred rivers are depicted conversing with sage Vishvamitra in a famous Rigvedic hymn?
qh: ऋग्वेद में विश्वामित्र नामक ऋषि का किन दो नदियों के साथ संवाद (Dialogue) वर्णित है?
e: Rigveda me sage Vishvamitra ka Beas (Vipash) aur Sutlej (Shutudri) nadiyo ke sath prayer dialogue document hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki rigved mein vishvamitr namak rishi ka kin do nadiyon ke sath sanvad (Dialogue) varnit hai? Isi tathya par Beas and Sutlej tika hua hai. Ganga and Yamuna, Narmada and Tapti, Indus and Jhelum anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Beas and Sutlej hi hai. Exam point: Beas and Sutlej - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Which sacrificial oblations were cast into the sacred fire during Vedic Yajna ceremonies?
qh: ऋग्वेद काल में 'यज्ञ' के दौरान आग में दी जाने वाली आहुति में मुख्य रूप से क्या शामिल था?
o: Ghee, barley grain, and animal offerings
e: Yajna fire me devtaon ko prasann karne ke liye ghee, cereal grains aur ritual offerings di jaati thi. Is prashn mein yah jaanna hai ki rigved kal mein 'yajn' ke dauran ag mein di jane vali ahuti mein mukhy rup se kya shamil tha? vedic kaal woh samay hai jab ved tatha yagya-karm pramukh the. Yahi wajah hai ki Ghee, barley grain, and animal offerings sahi hai. Gold and silver bullion, Silk garments, Carved stone tablets mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Ghee, barley grain, and animal offerings hi milti hai. Exam point: Ghee, barley grain, and animal offerings - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which two terms were employed in the Rigveda to denote the collective society or folk community?
qh: ऋग्वैदिक काल में जनता या पूरे समुदाय के लिए किन दो शब्दों का प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Community ya logon ke collective group ke liye Rigveda me 'Jana' aur 'Vish' (jisse Vaishya bana) words use hote the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rigvaidik kal mein janata ya pure samuday ke lie kin do shabdon ka prayog kiya jata tha? Yahi wajah hai ki Jana and Vish sahi hai. Arya and Dasa, Brahmin and Kshatriya, Rajan and Praja mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Jana and Vish hai. Exam point: Jana and Vish - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: What title did the authors of the Rigvedic hymns apply to themselves to distinguish from their adversaries?
qh: ऋग्वेद में जो लोग प्रार्थनाओं की रचना करते थे वे स्वयं को क्या कहते थे?
e: Hymn composers khud ko 'Arya' (noble) kehte the aur rival groups ko 'Dasa' ya 'Dasyu' kehte the. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki rigved mein jo log prarthanaon ki rachana karate the ve svayan ko kya kahate the? Isi aadhar par Aryas chuna jaata hai. Dasyus, Dasas, Panis is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Aryas hi hai. Exam point: Aryas - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: When did the architectural tradition of erecting stone Megalithic burial monuments originate in India?
qh: महापाषाण (Megaliths) कब्रें बनाने की प्रथा लगभग कितने वर्ष पूर्व शुरू हुई थी?
e: Megalithic stone circle aur cist burials lagbhag 1000 BCE (3000 saal pehle) South India, Deccan aur Kashmir me flourish hui. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki mahapashan (Megaliths) kabrein banane ki pratha lagabhag kitane varsh purv shuru hui thi? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par 3000 years ago sahi nikalta hai. 7000 years ago, 5000 years ago, 1000 years ago anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Sabhi baaton ke baad 3000 years ago hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: 3000 years ago - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: What architectural function was served by the 'Port-holes' found on box-like Megalithic stone cists?
qh: कब्रों में 'पोर्ट-होल' (Port-holes) का उपयोग किस लिए किया जाता था?
o: Entrance conduits to deposit subsequent deceased family members into the collective tomb
e: Stone cists me Port-holes entry passage ka kaam karte the taaki baad me family ke doosre dead members ko usi burial me dala ja sake. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki kabron mein 'port-hol' (Port-holes) ka upayog kis lie kiya jata tha? Isi baat se Entrance conduits to deposit subsequent deceased family members into the collective tomb sahi sabit hota hai. Water drainage channels, Displaying ornaments, Fresh ventilation mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Entrance conduits to deposit subsequent deceased family... hi hai. Exam point: Entrance conduits to deposit subsequent deceased family members into the collective tomb - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: The discovery of 33 gold beads alongside a single skeleton at Brahmagiri indicates what social reality?
qh: ब्रह्मगिरि में एक कब्र से 33 सोने के मनके और शंख मिले हैं, यह क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Pronounced social stratification and wealth inequality
e: Kuch graves me 33 gold beads aur shells milna aur kuch me sirf mitti ke bartan milna social hierarchy aur wealth disparity dikhata hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki brahmagiri mein ek kabr se 33 sone ke manake aur shankh mile hain, yah kya darshata hai? Isi tathya par Pronounced social stratification and wealth inequality tika hua hai. Baaki vikalp - Foreign invasion devastation, Egalitarian tribal harmony, Absence of religious beliefs - is vishay se mel nahi khaate. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Pronounced social stratification and wealth inequality hai. Exam point: Pronounced social stratification and wealth inequality - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: The Chalcolithic site of Inamgaon is situated along the river Ghod, which is a tributary of which major river?
qh: इनामगाँव (महाराष्ट्र) किस नदी की सहायक नदी 'घोड़' के किनारे स्थित है?
e: Maharashtra ka famous Inamgaon site Ghod river par situated hai, jo aage chalkar Bhima nadi se milti hai. Prashn yah saaf karna chahta hai ki inamaganv (maharashtr) kis nadi ki sahayak nadi 'ghod' ke kinare sthit hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Bhima hi sahi baithta hai. Galti Godavari, Narmada, Krishna chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Bhima hi hai. Exam point: Bhima - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: An elite burial at Inamgaon where a skeleton was interred inside a four-legged clay jar in a courtyard likely belonged to:
qh: इनामगाँव में एक विशिष्ट कब्र मिली है जहाँ शव को मिट्टी के बड़े जार में घर के आँगन में दफ़नाया गया था, यह किसकी कब्र हो सकती है?
o: A powerful village Chief or clan leader
e: House courtyard me 5-room mansion aur granary ke center me large 4-legged jar burial village ke paramount Chief ki status show karti hai. Yah prashn is tathya se juda hai ki inamaganv mein ek vishisht kabr mili hai jahan shav ko mitti ke badae jar mein ghar ke angan mein daphanaya gaya tha, yah kisaki kabr ho sakati hai? In tathyon ke chalte A powerful village Chief or clan leader hi sahi hai. An outcast slave, A young infant, An ordinary tenant cultivator is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar A powerful village Chief or clan leader hai. Exam point: A powerful village Chief or clan leader - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: Which anatomical bone structure do physical anthropologists examine to determine the biological sex of a skeleton?
qh: कंकाल के लिंग (Male/Female) की पहचान करने के लिए पुरातत्वविद मुख्य रूप से किस हड्डी की संरचना को देखते हैं?
e: Childbearing adaptation ki wajah se female pelvic bone male pelvis ke comparison me wider aur broader hoti hai. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki kankal ke ling (Male/Female) ki pahachan karane ke lie puratatvavid mukhy rup se kis haddi ki sanrachana ko dekhate hain? Isliye sahi nateeja Pelvic bone nikalta hai. Cranium, Humerus, Fibula is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Pelvic bone hi hai. Exam point: Pelvic bone - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: On what medium were the earliest records of Chinese writing inscribed during the Shang dynasty?
qh: प्राचीन चीन में लगभग 3500 साल पहले लेखन कला के साक्ष्य किस पर मिले हैं?
o: Oracle bones of oxen and turtle plastrons
e: Shang dynasty me diviners questions ko ox scapula aur turtle shells (Oracle Bones) par carve karke fire me test karte the. Is prashn mein poochha gaya hai ki prachin chin mein lagabhag 3500 sal pahale lekhan kala ke sakshy kis par mile hain? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Oracle bones of oxen and turtle plastrons hi sahi baithta hai. Vikalp Bamboo tablets, Monumental stele, Papyrus scrolls bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isi wajah se Oracle bones of oxen and turtle plastrons sahi hai. Exam point: Oracle bones of oxen and turtle plastrons - yah bindu yaad rakhne yogya hai.

qe: For what primary motives were tribal conflicts and cattle raids waged during the Rigvedic period?
qh: ऋग्वेद काल में 'युद्ध' मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए लड़े जाते थे?
o: Securing fertile pasture lands and water access
e: Rigvedic wars (Gavishti) primary wealth 'cattle' lene, pastures, water resources aur captives ke liye ladi jaati thi. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki rigved kal mein 'yuddh' mukhy rup se kisake lie ladae jate the? Yahi wajah hai ki All of the above sahi hai. Acquiring cattle herds, Securing fertile pasture lands and water access, Capturing human labor (slaves) is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab All of the above hai. Exam point: All of the above - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which structural features were completely absent in the political apparatus of Rigvedic tribal kings?
qh: ऋग्वैदिक काल के 'राजाओं' के पास निम्नलिखित में से क्या नहीं था?
e: Rigvedic Rajan tribal leader tha jiske paas na permanent palaces the, na standing army thi aur na hi regular tax collection. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki rigvaidik kal ke 'rajaon' ke pas nimnalikhit mein se kya nahin tha? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par All of the above sahi nikalta hai. Hereditary bureaucratic taxation, Palatial stone capitals, Permanent standing army alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan All of the above hi milti hai. Exam point: All of the above - is tathya ko aankdon ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: What specific terminology is used by archaeologists for the distinctive ceramic ware interred inside Megalithic graves?
qh: कब्रों में मृतकों के साथ मिलने वाले 'काले और लाल बर्तन' को पुरातत्वविद क्या कहते हैं?
e: Megalithic grave pits me dead ke sath rakhe inverted-fired pots ko Black and Red Ware (BRW) kehte hain. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki kabron mein mritakon ke sath milane vale 'kale aur lal bartan' ko puratatvavid kya kahate hain? Isliye sahi nateeja Black and Red Ware (BRW) nikalta hai. Vikalp Northern Black Polished Ware, Painted Grey Ware, Terra Sigillata bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab Black and Red Ware (BRW) hai. Exam point: Black and Red Ware (BRW) - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: To make the water-tight lining of the Great Bath at Mohenjo-daro, which natural sealant was applied?
qh: महान स्नानागार को 'वॉटर टाइट' बनाने के लिए ईंटों और प्लास्टर के ऊपर किसकी परत चढ़ाई गई थी?
e: Water seepage prevent karne ke liye bricks aur gypsum plaster ke beech natural bitumen (tar) ka thick coat lagaya gaya tha. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki mahan snanagar ko 'votar tait' banane ke lie inton aur plastar ke upar kisaki parat chadhai gai thi? Isliye antim jawab Natural bitumen / tar ke roop mein milta hai. Shell stucco, Crushed marble cement, Hydraulic lime alag khandan, kaal ya kshetra ke hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Natural bitumen / tar hi milti hai. Exam point: Natural bitumen / tar - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: From which distant overseas region did Harappan metallurgists import raw Copper?
qh: हड़प्पा के लोग 'तांबा' (Copper) मुख्य रूप से कहाँ से आयात करते थे?
o: Khetri mines in Rajasthan and Magan (Oman)
e: Harappans copper Rajasthan ki Khetri mines se aur maritime trade ke zariye Arabian peninsula ke Oman (Magan) se mangwate the. Prashn yah batata hai ki hadappa ke log 'tanba' (Copper) mukhy rup se kahan se ayat karate the? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isi karan se Khetri mines in Rajasthan and Magan (Oman) sahi uttar hai. Southern Deccan, Northern Badakhshan, Kolar mines in Karnataka mein is tathya ka sahi rang nahi milta. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Khetri mines in Rajasthan and Magan (Oman) hai. Exam point: Khetri mines in Rajasthan and Magan (Oman) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: How was the unique urban layout of Dholavira in the Rann of Kutch differentiated from other Harappan cities?
qh: धौलावीरा (गुजरात) नगर हड़प्पा के अन्य नगरों से किस प्रकार भिन्न था?
o: It was fortified into three distinct tripartite sectors (Citadel, Middle Town, Lower Town)
e: Dholavira do parts ke bajay 3 parts (Citadel, Middle town, Lower town) me divided tha aur isme massive stone masonry aur reservoirs the. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki dhaulavira (gujarat) nagar hadappa ke any nagaron se kis prakar bhinn tha? Harappan sabhyata sindhu ghati ki woh sabhyata hai jo shehron ki yojna tatha mohron ke liye jaani jaati hai. Isi baat se It was fortified into three distinct tripartite sectors (Citadel, Middle Town, Lower Town) sahi sabit hota hai. It lacked any water reservoirs, It was unfortified, It had no stone masonry is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad It was fortified into three distinct tripartite sectors (Citadel, Middle Town, Lower Town) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: It was fortified into three distinct tripartite... - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which of the following historical factors is NOT a plausible cause for the decline of the Indus Valley Civilization?
qh: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के पतन के संभावित कारणों में कौन सा शामिल नहीं है?
o: Catastrophic local flooding and tectonic shifts
Shifting and drying up of river channels
Deforestation and loss of green pastoral cover
e: Desiccation of rivers, ecological deforestation aur trade breakdown collapse ke scientific reasons hain; nuclear war mythical claim hai. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki hadappa sabhyata ke patan ke sanbhavit karanon mein kaun sa shamil nahin hai? Isi tathya par Atomic / Nuclear warfare tika hua hai. Vikalp Catastrophic local flooding and tectonic shifts, Shifting and drying up of river channels, Deforestation and loss of green pastoral cover bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Yahi sahi uttar Atomic / Nuclear warfare hai. Exam point: Atomic / Nuclear warfare - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: What climatic transformation around 12,000 years ago catalyzed the emergence of open grasslands and human foraging shifts?
qh: इतिहास में लगभग 12,000 साल पहले कौन सा महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आया जिसने मानव जीवन को बदल दिया?
o: Beginning of a harsh glacial Ice Age
Complete drying of all continental oceans
Pleistocene-Holocene transition marked by global warming and expansion of grasslands
e: 12,000 saal pehle Ice Age end hua aur climate warmer hone se grasslands phaili, jisse herbivores badhe aur human agriculture shuru hua. Is prashn mein mukhya baat yah hai ki itihas mein lagabhag 12,000 sal pahale kaun sa mahatvapurn badalav aya jisane manav jivan ko badal diya? Yahi wajah hai ki Pleistocene-Holocene transition marked by global warming and expansion of grasslands sahi hai. Vikalp Beginning of a harsh glacial Ice Age, Complete drying of all continental oceans, Widespread volcanic nuclear winter bhi is tathya ke dayre se baahar hain. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Pleistocene-Holocene transition marked by global warming and expansion of grasslands hai. Exam point: Pleistocene-Holocene transition marked by global warming and expansion of grasslands - yahi is prashn ki mukhya baat hai.

qe: What archaeological evidence from the Kurnool Caves in Andhra Pradesh attests to the knowledge of fire in the Paleolithic?
qh: राख के अवशेष (Ash remains) किस गुफा से मिले हैं, जो आग की जानकारी का प्रमाण देते हैं?
e: Kurnool caves se ash ke remnants mile hain jo confirm karte hain ki wahan ke hunter-gatherers fire use karna jante the. Is prashn ka seedha matlab yah hai ki rakh ke avashesh (Ash remains) kis gupha se mile hain, jo ag ki janakari ka praman dete hain? Isliye sahi nateeja Kurnool Caves nikalta hai. Galti Bhimbetka, Ajanta Caves, Hunsgi Valley chunne se hoti hai kyunki inka is tathya se talmel nahi hai. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Kurnool Caves hi milti hai. Exam point: Kurnool Caves - yah baat pariksha mein baar-baar poochhi jaati hai.

qe: Tiny, geometric stone microliths mounted on wood or bone handles are diagnostic of which archaeological epoch?
qh: 'माइक्रोलिथ' (Microliths) या लघु पाषाण औजार किस काल की विशेषता हैं?
e: Mesolithic phase me composite tools banane ke liye chote sharp stone blades 'Microliths' use hone lage. Sawaal is baat ka hai ki 'maikrolith' (Microliths) ya laghu pashan aujar kis kal ki visheshata hain? Isi karan se Mesolithic (Middle Stone Age) sahi uttar hai. Iron Age, Chalcolithic Age, Lower Paleolithic anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad Mesolithic (Middle Stone Age) hi theek uttar hai. Exam point: Mesolithic (Middle Stone Age) - ise tathya ke saath yaad rakhein.

qe: Which wild animal was the very first to be domesticated by foraging humans?
qh: इंसान ने सबसे पहले किस जानवर को पालतू बनाया था?
e: Hunter-gatherers ne sabse pehle wild dog ke ancestor ko camps me food scraps dekar taming karna shuru kiya tha. Prashn ka saar yah hai ki insan ne sabase pahale kis janavar ko palatu banaya tha? In tathyon ke chalte Wild ancestor of the dog hi sahi hai. Domestic horse, Humped cow, Wild sheep is prashn ke vishay se door pade hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan Wild ancestor of the dog hi milti hai. Exam point: Wild ancestor of the dog - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Subterranean 'Pit-houses' with stepped earthen entryways dug to survive bitter cold were excavated at which Neolithic site?
qh: बुर्जहोम (वर्तमान कश्मीर) में लोग गड्ढे के नीचे घर बनाते थे, उन्हें क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Kashmir ke Burzahom me zameen ke andar dig kiye gaye Pit-houses mile hain jinki step entry hoti thi aur hearths andar hoti thi. Is prashn ka vishay Pit-houses at Burzahom hai. Isi aadhar par Pit-houses at Burzahom chuna jaata hai. Piklihal, Daojali Hading, Mehrgarh anya kaal, vyakti ya ghatna se jude hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab Pit-houses at Burzahom hai. Exam point: Pit-houses at Burzahom - ise kaal-kram mein baithakar yaad karein.

qe: Near which strategic mountain pass to the Iranian plateau is the early agricultural site of Mehrgarh located?
qh: मेहरगढ़ (वर्तमान पाकिस्तान) किस महत्वपूर्ण दर्रे के पास स्थित है?
e: Balochistan me Mehrgarh fertile Bolan Pass route par situated hai jo Iran aur Central Asia ko connect karta hai. Yahaan poochha gaya hai ki meharagadh (vartaman pakistan) kis mahatvapurn darre ke pas sthit hai? Isliye antim jawab Bolan Pass ke roop mein milta hai. Gomal Pass, Nathu La, Khyber Pass ko chunne par jawab galat ho jaayega. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Bolan Pass hi hai. Exam point: Bolan Pass - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: The English noun 'India' is etymologically derived from which ancient Sanskrit geographic river name?
qh: इंडिया (India) शब्द किस संस्कृत शब्द से निकला है?
e: Greeks ne Indus river ke Sanskrit naam 'Sindhu' ko 'Indos' bola, jisse aage chalkar 'India' word derive hua. Prashn is baat par tika hai ki indiya (India) shabd kis sanskrit shabd se nikala hai? Isi baat se Sindhu (Indus) sahi sabit hota hai. Bharat, Hindos, Saraswati in tathyon se hatt kar jaate hain. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Sindhu (Indus) hi hai. Exam point: Sindhu (Indus) - isse jude tathya yaad rakhein.

qe: The bilingual rock edict of Emperor Ashoka discovered at Kandahar was inscribed in which two scripts and languages?
qh: अशोक का कंधार अभिलेख किन दो लिपियों/भाषाओं में लिखा गया है?
e: Afghanistan ke Kandahar me Ashoka ka bilingual inscription Greek aur Aramaic scripts aur languages me carved mila hai. Is prashn ka mool sawaal yah hai ki ashok ka kandhar abhilekh kin do lipiyon/bhashaon mein likha gaya hai? Diye gaye tathya ke aadhar par Greek and Aramaic sahi nikalta hai. Latin and Arabic, Brahmi and Kharosthi, Sanskrit and Tamil is baat ki sahi jaankari nahi dete. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar Greek and Aramaic hi hai.
